73/* Default open-file soft-limit target: covers C1M's one-fd-per-connection
74 * budget with headroom. Overridable via CWIST_FD_LIMIT_TARGET for
75 * deployments that need a different budget (a smaller container quota, or a
76 * larger one for a workload with more fds-per-connection than plain HTTP -
77 * e.g. proxying, or per-connection log/temp files). */
78#define CWIST_DEFAULT_FD_LIMIT_TARGET ((rlim_t)1050000)
79
83static void cwist_app_tune_system(void) {
84#ifdef __wasi__
85 /* WASI preview1 has no rlimit; fd budgeting is the host's concern. */
86#else
87 struct rlimit rl;
88 if (getrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, &rl) != 0) {
89 fprintf(stderr, "[CWIST] Cannot read file limits: %s\n", strerror(errno));
90 return;
91 }
92 /* Keep the hard limit. Increase the soft limit only, up to a tunable
93 * target - CWIST_FD_LIMIT_TARGET overrides the default when set to a
94 * valid positive integer; any other value (unset, empty, non-numeric,
95 * trailing garbage, zero or negative) falls back to the default rather
96 * than silently using 0 or a partially-parsed number. */
97 rlim_t target = CWIST_DEFAULT_FD_LIMIT_TARGET;
98 const char *fd_limit_env = getenv("CWIST_FD_LIMIT_TARGET");
99 if (fd_limit_env && fd_limit_env[0]) {
100 char *end = NULL;
101 errno = 0;
102 long parsed = strtol(fd_limit_env, &end, 10);
103 if (errno == 0 && end && *end == '\0' && parsed > 0) {
104 target = (rlim_t)parsed;
105 } else {
106 fprintf(stderr,
107 "[CWIST] Ignoring invalid CWIST_FD_LIMIT_TARGET=\"%s\" (using default %llu)\n",
108 fd_limit_env, (unsigned long long)CWIST_DEFAULT_FD_LIMIT_TARGET);
109 }
110 }
111 if (rl.rlim_max != RLIM_INFINITY && target > rl.rlim_max) {
112 target = rl.rlim_max;
113 }
114 if (rl.rlim_cur < target) {
115 rl.rlim_cur = target;
116 if (setrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, &rl) != 0) {
117 fprintf(stderr, "[CWIST] Cannot increase file limit: %s\n", strerror(errno));
118 return;
119 }
120 }
121 printf("[CWIST] Open file soft limit: %llu\n", (unsigned long long)rl.rlim_cur);
122#endif
123}
124#endif

137/* The static-file memory cache rides on libttak's mem tree and a watcher
138 * thread; WASM hosts get neither (cwist_prepare_static() always declines). */
146static bool cwist_mem_has_capacity(cwist_fix_server_mem *mem, size_t incoming, size_t reclaimable) {
147 if (!mem || mem->total_capacity == 0) {
148 return true;
149 }
150 if (incoming > mem->total_capacity) {
151 return false;
152 }
153 size_t used = mem->current_used;
154 if (reclaimable > used) {
155 reclaimable = used;
156 }
157 size_t projected = used - reclaimable + incoming;
158 return projected <= mem->total_capacity;
159}

166static cwist_file_t *cwist_mem_claim_entry(cwist_fix_server_mem *mem) {
167 if (!mem) return NULL;
168 if (mem->file_count >= mem->files_capacity) {
169 size_t new_cap = mem->files_capacity == 0 ? 16 : mem->files_capacity * 2;
170 cwist_file_t *new_files = cwist_realloc(mem->files, new_cap * sizeof(cwist_file_t));
171 if (!new_files) {
172 return NULL;
173 }
174 mem->files = new_files;
175 mem->files_capacity = new_cap;
176 }
177 cwist_file_t *entry = &mem->files[mem->file_count];
178 memset(entry, 0, sizeof(*entry));
179 mem->file_count++;
180 return entry;
181}

192static bool cwist_mem_create_payload(cwist_fix_server_mem *mem, const char *fs_path, size_t size,
193 void **data_out, ttak_mem_node_t **node_out) {
194 if (!mem || !fs_path || !data_out || !node_out) return false;
195
196 void *buffer = ttak_mem_alloc_safe(size ? size : 1, __TTAK_UNSAFE_MEM_FOREVER__,
197 cwist_mem_now(), true, false, true, true, TTAK_MEM_DEFAULT);
198 if (!buffer) {
199 fprintf(stderr, "[StaticMem] Failed to allocate %zu bytes via libttak for %s\n", size,
200 fs_path);
201 return false;
202 }
203
204 FILE *f = fopen(fs_path, "rb");
205 if (!f) {
206 fprintf(stderr, "[StaticMem] Failed to open %s\n", fs_path);
207 ttak_mem_free(buffer);
208 return false;
209 }
210
211 size_t to_read = size;
212 if (to_read > 0) {
213 size_t read = fread(buffer, 1, to_read, f);
214 if (read != to_read) {
215 fprintf(stderr, "[StaticMem] Short read for %s (expected %zu, got %zu)\n", fs_path,
216 to_read, read);
217 fclose(f);
218 ttak_mem_free(buffer);
219 return false;
220 }
221 }
222 fclose(f);
223
224 ttak_mem_node_t *node = ttak_mem_tree_add(&mem->file_tree, buffer, size ? size : 1,
225 __TTAK_UNSAFE_MEM_FOREVER__, true);
226 if (!node) {
227 ttak_mem_free(buffer);
228 return false;
229 }
230
231 *data_out = buffer;
232 *node_out = node;
233 return true;
234}

241static void cwist_mem_release_node_delayed(cwist_fix_server_mem *mem, ttak_mem_node_t *node) {
242 if (!mem || !node) return;
243 uint64_t now = cwist_mem_now();
244 pthread_mutex_lock(&node->lock);
245 node->expires_tick = now + mem->retire_grace_ns;
246 pthread_mutex_unlock(&node->lock);
247 ttak_mem_node_release(node);
248}

260static bool cwist_mem_attach_entry(cwist_fix_server_mem *mem, cwist_file_t *entry,
261 const char *fs_path, const struct stat *st, void *data,
262 ttak_mem_node_t *node) {
263 if (!mem || !entry || !fs_path || !st) return false;
264 char *path_copy = cwist_strdup(fs_path);
265 if (!path_copy) {
266 ttak_mem_tree_remove(&mem->file_tree, node);
267 return false;
268 }
269
270 entry->path = NULL;
271 entry->fs_path = path_copy;
272 entry->data = data;
273 entry->size = st->st_size;
274 entry->last_mod = st->st_mtime;
275 snprintf(entry->etag, sizeof(entry->etag), "\"%lx-%lx\"", (unsigned long)st->st_mtime,
276 (unsigned long)st->st_size);
277 cwist_http_format_date(st->st_mtime, entry->last_mod_hdr, sizeof(entry->last_mod_hdr));
278 entry->node = node;
279
280 mem->current_used += st->st_size;
281 return true;
282}

291static bool cwist_mem_register_file(cwist_fix_server_mem *mem, const char *fs_path,
292 const struct stat *st) {
293 if (!mem || !fs_path || !st) return false;
294 if (!cwist_mem_has_capacity(mem, st->st_size, 0)) {
295 fprintf(stderr, "[StaticMem] Skipping %s (size %zu exceeds capacity)\n", fs_path,
296 st->st_size);
297 return false;
298 }
299 cwist_file_t *entry = cwist_mem_claim_entry(mem);
300 if (!entry) {
301 fprintf(stderr, "[StaticMem] Failed to allocate metadata entry for %s\n", fs_path);
302 return false;
303 }
304 void *data = NULL;
305 ttak_mem_node_t *node = NULL;
306 if (!cwist_mem_create_payload(mem, fs_path, st->st_size, &data, &node)) {
307 mem->file_count--;
308 return false;
309 }
310 if (!cwist_mem_attach_entry(mem, entry, fs_path, st, data, node)) {
311 mem->file_count--;
312 return false;
313 }
314 return true;
315}

324static bool cwist_mem_refresh_file(cwist_fix_server_mem *mem, cwist_file_t *entry,
325 const struct stat *st) {
326 if (!mem || !entry || !st) return false;
327 size_t reclaimable = entry->size;
328 if (!cwist_mem_has_capacity(mem, st->st_size, reclaimable)) {
329 fprintf(stderr, "[StaticMem] OOM reloading %s (%zu bytes)\n", entry->fs_path,
330 (size_t)st->st_size);
331 return false;
332 }
333
334 void *data = NULL;
335 ttak_mem_node_t *node = NULL;
336 if (!cwist_mem_create_payload(mem, entry->fs_path, st->st_size, &data, &node)) {
337 return false;
338 }
339
340 ttak_mem_node_t *old_node = entry->node;
341 size_t old_size = entry->size;
342
343 entry->data = data;
344 entry->node = node;
345 entry->size = st->st_size;
346 entry->last_mod = st->st_mtime;
347 snprintf(entry->etag, sizeof(entry->etag), "\"%lx-%lx\"", (unsigned long)st->st_mtime,
348 (unsigned long)st->st_size);
349 cwist_http_format_date(st->st_mtime, entry->last_mod_hdr, sizeof(entry->last_mod_hdr));
350
351 if (mem->current_used >= old_size) {
352 mem->current_used -= old_size;
353 } else {
354 mem->current_used = 0;
355 }
356 mem->current_used += st->st_size;
357
358 if (old_node) {
359 cwist_mem_release_node_delayed(mem, old_node);
360 }
361 return true;
362}

456static size_t cwist_route_hash(cwist_http_method_t method, const char *path, size_t path_len,
457 size_t bucket_count) {
458 const unsigned long long FNV_OFFSET = 1469598103934665603ULL;
459 const unsigned long long FNV_PRIME = 1099511628211ULL;
460 unsigned long long hash = FNV_OFFSET ^ (unsigned long long)method;
461 const unsigned char *ptr = (const unsigned char *)path;
462 for (size_t i = 0; i < path_len; i++) {
463 hash ^= (unsigned long long)ptr[i];
464 hash *= FNV_PRIME;
465 }
466 return (size_t)(hash % bucket_count);
467}

487static cwist_route_entry *cwist_route_entry_create(const char *path, const char *name,
488 cwist_http_method_t method,
489 const cwist_route_target *target,
490 cwist_endpoint_opt_t opts) {
491 cwist_route_entry *entry = (cwist_route_entry *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(cwist_route_entry));
492 if (!entry) return NULL;
493 entry->path = cwist_strdup(path ? path : "/");
494 entry->name = name ? cwist_strdup(name) : NULL;
495 if (!entry->path || (name && !entry->name)) {
496 cwist_free(entry->path);
497 cwist_free(entry->name);
498 cwist_free(entry);
499 return NULL;
500 }
501 entry->path_len = strlen(entry->path);
502 entry->method = method;
503 cwist_route_entry_set_target(entry, target);
504 entry->opts = opts;
505 entry->has_params = route_has_params(entry->path);
506 entry->next = NULL;
507 return entry;
508}

522static cwist_route_table *cwist_route_table_create(void) {
523 cwist_route_table *table = (cwist_route_table *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(cwist_route_table));
524 if (!table) return NULL;
525 table->bucket_count = CWIST_ROUTE_BUCKETS;
526 table->buckets =
527 (cwist_route_entry **)cwist_alloc_array(table->bucket_count, sizeof(cwist_route_entry *));
528 if (!table->buckets) {
529 cwist_free(table);
530 return NULL;
531 }
532 table->param_routes = NULL;
533 return table;

540static void cwist_route_table_destroy(cwist_route_table *table) {
541 if (!table) return;
542 for (size_t i = 0; i < table->bucket_count; i++) {
543 cwist_route_entry *curr = table->buckets[i];
544 while (curr) {
545 cwist_route_entry *next = curr->next;
546 cwist_route_entry_free(curr);
547 curr = next;
548 }
549 }
550 cwist_free(table->buckets);
551
552 cwist_route_entry *param = table->param_routes;
553 while (param) {
554 cwist_route_entry *next = param->next;
555 cwist_route_entry_free(param);
556 param = next;
557 }
558 cwist_free(table);
559}

569static bool cwist_route_table_insert(cwist_route_table *table, const char *path, const char *name,
570 cwist_http_method_t method, const cwist_route_target *target,
571 cwist_endpoint_opt_t opts) {
572 cwist_route_entry *entry =
573 (table && path) ? cwist_route_entry_create(path, name, method, target, opts) : NULL;
574 if (!entry) {
575 if (target->ctx_destroy) target->ctx_destroy(target->user_ctx);
576 return false;
577 }
578
579 if (entry->has_params) {
580 entry->next = table->param_routes;
581 table->param_routes = entry;
582 return true;
583 }
584
585 size_t idx = cwist_route_hash(method, entry->path, entry->path_len, table->bucket_count);
586 cwist_route_entry **bucket = &table->buckets[idx];
587 cwist_route_entry *curr = *bucket;
588 while (curr) {
589 if (!curr->has_params && curr->method == method && strcmp(curr->path, entry->path) == 0) {
590 /* Re-registering the same non-NULL context keeps it alive; anything else
591 * releases the old one before the new target takes over. */
592 if (!target->user_ctx || curr->user_ctx != target->user_ctx) {
593 cwist_route_entry_release_ctx(curr);
594 }
595 cwist_route_entry_set_target(curr, target);
596 curr->opts = opts;
597 /* The replacement entry never owned the context now in curr. */
598 entry->ctx_destroy = NULL;
599 cwist_route_entry_free(entry);
600 return true;
601 }
602 curr = curr->next;
603 }
604
605 entry->next = *bucket;
606 *bucket = entry;
607 return true;
608}

610static cwist_route_entry *cwist_route_table_lookup(cwist_route_table *table,
611 cwist_http_method_t method, const char *path) {
612 if (!table || !path) return NULL;
613 /* One scan of the path: length feeds both the hash and the compare. */
614 size_t path_len = strlen(path);
615 size_t idx = cwist_route_hash(method, path, path_len, table->bucket_count);
616 cwist_route_entry *curr = table->buckets[idx];
617
618 uint64_t path_u64 = 0;
619 const bool use_fast_path = (path_len <= 8);
620 if (use_fast_path) {
621 memcpy(&path_u64, path, path_len); // Safe copy
622 }
623
624 while (curr) {
625 if (curr->method == method) {
626 if (use_fast_path) {
627 /* Length is cached on the entry; immutable after insert. */
628 if (curr->path_len == path_len) {
629 uint64_t curr_u64 = 0;
630 memcpy(&curr_u64, curr->path, curr->path_len);
631 if (path_u64 == curr_u64) return curr;
632 }
633 } else {
634 if (curr->path_len == path_len && memcmp(curr->path, path, path_len) == 0) {
635 return curr;
636 }
637 }
638 }
639 curr = curr->next;
640 }
641 return NULL;
642}

644static cwist_route_entry *cwist_route_table_match_params(cwist_route_table *table,
645 cwist_http_request *req) {
646 if (!table || !req || !req->path || !req->path->data) return NULL;
647 cwist_route_entry *curr = table->param_routes;
648 while (curr) {
649 if (curr->method == req->method) {
650 if (!req->path_params) {
651 /* Probe without capturing: no heap alloc, no map clearing per
652 * candidate. Only a confirmed match pays for the params map. */
653 if (match_path(curr->path, req->path->data, NULL)) {
654 req->path_params = cwist_query_map_create();
655 if (!req->path_params) return NULL;
656 match_path(curr->path, req->path->data, req->path_params);
657 return curr;
658 }
659 } else if (match_path(curr->path, req->path->data, req->path_params)) {
660 return curr;
661 }
662 }
663 curr = curr->next;
664 }
665 return NULL;
666}

672static size_t cwist_url_decode(const char *src, char *dst, size_t dst_size) {
673 size_t i = 0, j = 0;
674 while (src[i] && j + 1 < dst_size) {
675 if (src[i] == '%' && isxdigit((unsigned char)src[i + 1]) &&
676 isxdigit((unsigned char)src[i + 2])) {
677 char hex[3] = {src[i + 1], src[i + 2], '\0'};
678 dst[j++] = (char)strtol(hex, NULL, 16);
679 i += 3;
680 } else if (src[i] == '+') {
681 dst[j++] = ' ';
682 i++;
683 } else {
684 dst[j++] = src[i++];
685 }
686 }
687 dst[j] = '\0';
688 return j;
689}

696static bool cwist_path_has_parent_ref(const char *path) {
697 if (!path) return false;
698 const char *cursor = path;
699 while (*cursor) {
700 if (*cursor == '.') {
701 char prev = (cursor == path) ? '/' : *(cursor - 1);
702 char next = *(cursor + 1);
703 char next_next = *(cursor + 2);
704 if (prev == '/' && next == '.' && (next_next == '/' || next_next == '\0')) {
705 return true;
706 }
707 }
708 cursor++;
709 }
710 return false;
711}
712
721static bool cwist_static_match_entry(const cwist_static_dir *entry, const char *req_path,
722 const char **relative_ptr, bool *use_index) {
723 if (!entry || !req_path || req_path[0] == '\0') return false;
724 size_t prefix_len = strlen(entry->url_prefix);
725 if (prefix_len == 0) return false;
726 if (prefix_len == 1 && entry->url_prefix[0] == '/') {
727 if (req_path[0] != '/') return false;
728 if (req_path[1] == '\0') {
729 if (use_index) *use_index = true;
730 if (relative_ptr) *relative_ptr = NULL;
731 } else {
732 if (use_index) *use_index = false;
733 if (relative_ptr) *relative_ptr = req_path + 1;
734 }
735 return true;
736 }
737
738 if (strncmp(req_path, entry->url_prefix, prefix_len) != 0) {
739 return false;
740 }
741
742 char separator = req_path[prefix_len];
743 if (separator == '\0') {
744 if (use_index) *use_index = true;
745 if (relative_ptr) *relative_ptr = NULL;
746 return true;
747 }
748 if (separator != '/') {
749 return false;
750 }
751 if (use_index) *use_index = false;
752 if (relative_ptr) *relative_ptr = req_path + prefix_len + 1;
753 return true;
754}
755
763static bool cwist_prepare_static(cwist_app *app, cwist_http_request *req,
764 cwist_static_request_info *info) {
765#if defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) || defined(__wasi__)
766 /* No filesystem-backed static cache in WASM hosts. */
767 (void)app;
768 (void)req;
769 (void)info;
770 return false;
771#else
772 if (!app || !req || !req->path || !req->path->data) return false;
773 if (!app->static_dirs) return false;
774 if (req->method != CWIST_HTTP_GET && req->method != CWIST_HTTP_HEAD) return false;
775
776 cwist_static_dir *entry = app->static_dirs;
777 const char *path = req->path->data;
778 while (entry) {
779 bool use_index = false;
780 const char *relative = NULL;
781 if (cwist_static_match_entry(entry, path, &relative, &use_index)) {
782 if (info) {
783 info->mapping = entry;
784 info->relative_ptr = relative;
785 info->use_index = use_index;
786 }
787 return true;
788 }
789 entry = entry->next;
790 }
791 return false;
792#endif
793}

803static void cwist_scan_recursive(const char *fs_root, size_t *total_size, cwist_fix_server_mem *mem,
804 bool dry_run) {
805 DIR *d = opendir(fs_root);
806 if (!d) return;
807
808 struct dirent *dir;
809 char full_path[PATH_MAX];
810 struct stat st;
811
812 while ((dir = readdir(d)) != NULL) {
813 if (strcmp(dir->d_name, ".") == 0 || strcmp(dir->d_name, "..") == 0) continue;
814
815 snprintf(full_path, sizeof(full_path), "%s/%s", fs_root, dir->d_name);
816 if (stat(full_path, &st) == -1) continue;
817
818 if (S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) {
819 cwist_scan_recursive(full_path, total_size, mem, dry_run);
820 } else if (S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) {
821 if (dry_run) {
822 if (total_size) *total_size += st.st_size;
823 } else if (mem) {
824 if (!cwist_mem_register_file(mem, full_path, &st)) {
825 fprintf(stderr, "[StaticMem] Failed to load %s\n", full_path);
826 }
827 }
828 }
829 }
830 closedir(d);
831}

837static void cwist_mem_init(cwist_app *app) {
838 if (!app || !app->static_dirs) return;
839
840 app->mem_manager = cwist_alloc(sizeof(cwist_fix_server_mem));
841 app->mem_manager->check_interval_ms = 2000;
842 pthread_mutex_init(&app->mem_manager->lock, NULL);
843 app->mem_manager->retire_grace_ns = CWIST_STATIC_RETIRE_NS;
844 ttak_mem_tree_init(&app->mem_manager->file_tree);
845
846 size_t total_size = 0;
847 cwist_static_dir *curr = app->static_dirs;
848 while (curr) {
849 cwist_scan_recursive(curr->fs_root, &total_size, NULL, true);
850 curr = curr->next;
851 }
852
853 if (app->max_mem_space > 0) {
854 app->mem_manager->total_capacity = app->max_mem_space;
855 } else {
856 if (total_size == 0) total_size = CWIST_MIB(1);
857 app->mem_manager->total_capacity = total_size * 2;
858 }
859
860 app->mem_manager->current_used = 0;
861
862 // Load files
863 curr = app->static_dirs;
864 while (curr) {
865 cwist_scan_recursive(curr->fs_root, NULL, app->mem_manager, false);
866 curr = curr->next;
867 }
868
869 printf("Server Memory Initialized: %zu used / %zu total bytes (%zu files)\n",
870 app->mem_manager->current_used, app->mem_manager->total_capacity,
871 app->mem_manager->file_count);
872}

874static void *cwist_mem_watcher(void *arg) {
875 cwist_app *app = (cwist_app *)arg;
876 cwist_fix_server_mem *mem = app->mem_manager;
877
878 while (mem->watcher_running) {
879 usleep(mem->check_interval_ms * 1000);
880
881 pthread_mutex_lock(&mem->lock);
882 for (size_t i = 0; i < mem->file_count; i++) {
883 cwist_file_t *f = &mem->files[i];
884 struct stat st;
885 if (stat(f->fs_path, &st) == 0) {
886 if (st.st_mtime > f->last_mod) {
887 if (cwist_mem_refresh_file(mem, f, &st)) {
888 printf("[Hot Reload] Updated: %s\n", f->fs_path);
889 }
890 }
891 }
892 }
893 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mem->lock);
894 }
895 return NULL;
896}

898static cwist_file_t *cwist_mem_get_file(cwist_fix_server_mem *mem, const char *fs_path) {
899 if (!mem || !fs_path) return NULL;
900 for (size_t i = 0; i < mem->file_count; i++) {
901 if (strcmp(mem->files[i].fs_path, fs_path) == 0) {
902 return &mem->files[i];
903 }
904 }
905 return NULL;
906}

909static char *cwist_normalize_prefix(const char *prefix) {
910 if (!prefix || prefix[0] == '\0') {
911 return cwist_strdup("/");
912 }
913
914 size_t len = strlen(prefix);
915 bool needs_leading_slash = prefix[0] != '/';
916 char *buffer = (char *)cwist_alloc(len + needs_leading_slash + 1);
917 if (!buffer) {
918 return NULL;
919 }
920
921 if (needs_leading_slash) {
922 buffer[0] = '/';
923 memcpy(buffer + 1, prefix, len + 1);
924 len += 1;
925 } else {
926 memcpy(buffer, prefix, len + 1);
927 }
928
929 while (len > 1 && buffer[len - 1] == '/') {
930 buffer[len - 1] = '\0';
931 len--;
932 }
933
934 return buffer;
935}
936
937static char *cwist_normalize_directory(const char *directory) {
938 if (!directory || directory[0] == '\0') {
939 directory = ".";
940 }
941 char *resolved = realpath(directory, NULL);
942 if (resolved) {
943 return resolved;
944 }
945 /* Fallback when the path does not yet exist: strip trailing slashes */
946 size_t len = strlen(directory);
947 while (len > 1 && directory[len - 1] == '/') {
948 len--;
949 }
950 char *copy = (char *)cwist_alloc(len + 1);
951 if (!copy) return NULL;
952 memcpy(copy, directory, len);
953 copy[len] = '\0';
954 return copy;
955}

978static void cwist_static_handler(cwist_http_request *req, cwist_http_response *res) {
979 mw_executor_ctx *ctx = (mw_executor_ctx *)req->private_data;
980 cwist_static_request_info *info = ctx ? (cwist_static_request_info *)ctx->handler_data : NULL;
981 if (!info || !info->mapping) {
982 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_INTERNAL_ERROR;
983 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "Static handler misconfigured");
984 return;
985 }
986
987 char relative_buf[PATH_MAX];
988 if (info->use_index || !info->relative_ptr || info->relative_ptr[0] == '\0') {
989 snprintf(relative_buf, sizeof(relative_buf), "index.html");
990 } else {
991 snprintf(relative_buf, sizeof(relative_buf), "%s", info->relative_ptr);
992 }
993 relative_buf[PATH_MAX - 1] = '\0';
994
995 char decoded_relative[PATH_MAX];
996 cwist_url_decode(relative_buf, decoded_relative, sizeof(decoded_relative));
997
998 if (cwist_path_has_parent_ref(decoded_relative)) {
999 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_FORBIDDEN;
1000 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "Directory traversal blocked");
1001 return;
1002 }
1003
1004 char fs_path[PATH_MAX];
1005 int written =
1006 snprintf(fs_path, sizeof(fs_path), "%s/%s", info->mapping->fs_root, decoded_relative);
1007 if (written < 0 || written >= (int)sizeof(fs_path)) {
1008 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_BAD_REQUEST;
1009 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "Static path too long");
1010 return;
1011 }
1012
1013 char canonical[PATH_MAX];
1014 if (!realpath(fs_path, canonical)) {
1015 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_NOT_FOUND;
1016 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "Not Found");
1017 return;
1018 }
1019
1020 /* Ensure the resolved path stays inside the configured static root */
1021 size_t root_len = strlen(info->mapping->fs_root);
1022 if (strncmp(canonical, info->mapping->fs_root, root_len) != 0 ||
1023 (canonical[root_len] != '/' && canonical[root_len] != '\0')) {
1024 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_FORBIDDEN;
1025 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "Directory traversal blocked");
1026 return;
1027 }
1028
1029 cwist_app *app = req->app;
1030 if (!app || !app->mem_manager) {
1031 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_INTERNAL_ERROR;
1032 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "Server memory not initialized");
1033 return;
1034 }
1035
1036 cwist_fix_server_mem *mem = app->mem_manager;
1037 pthread_mutex_lock(&mem->lock);
1038 cwist_file_t *file = cwist_mem_get_file(mem, canonical);
1039
1040 if (file) {
1041 // Simple MIME guess
1042 const char *dot = strrchr(canonical, '.');
1043 const char *mime = "application/octet-stream";
1044 if (dot) {
1045 if (strcasecmp(dot, ".html") == 0)
1046 mime = "text/html; charset=utf-8";
1047 else if (strcasecmp(dot, ".css") == 0)
1048 mime = "text/css; charset=utf-8";
1049 else if (strcasecmp(dot, ".js") == 0)
1050 mime = "application/javascript";
1051 else if (strcasecmp(dot, ".json") == 0)
1052 mime = "application/json";
1053 else if (strcasecmp(dot, ".png") == 0)
1054 mime = "image/png";
1055 else if (strcasecmp(dot, ".jpg") == 0 || strcasecmp(dot, ".jpeg") == 0)
1056 mime = "image/jpeg";
1057 else if (strcasecmp(dot, ".gif") == 0)
1058 mime = "image/gif";
1059 else if (strcasecmp(dot, ".svg") == 0)
1060 mime = "image/svg+xml";
1061 else if (strcasecmp(dot, ".txt") == 0)
1062 mime = "text/plain; charset=utf-8";
1063 }
1064
1065 // Cache headers are formatted once at load/reload time.
1066 const char *etag = file->etag;
1067 const char *last_mod_buf = file->last_mod_hdr;
1068
1069 // Check conditional requests
1070 bool not_modified = false;
1071 const char *if_none_match = cwist_http_header_get(req->headers, "If-None-Match");
1072 if (if_none_match && strcmp(if_none_match, etag) == 0) {
1073 not_modified = true;
1074 } else {
1075 const char *if_modified_since =
1076 cwist_http_header_get(req->headers, "If-Modified-Since");
1077 if (if_modified_since) {
1078 time_t ims = cwist_http_parse_date(if_modified_since);
1079 if (ims != (time_t)-1 && file->last_mod <= ims) {
1080 not_modified = true;
1081 }
1082 }
1083 }
1084
1085 if (not_modified) {
1086 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_NOT_MODIFIED; // 304
1087 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "ETag", etag);
1088 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Last-Modified", last_mod_buf);
1089 const char *cc = info->mapping->cache_control ? info->mapping->cache_control
1090 : "public, max-age=3600";
1091 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Cache-Control", cc);
1092 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "");
1093 } else {
1094 /* HEAD falls through here: app_serve_parsed_request suppresses the
1095 * body at send time for every route, so only the headers matter. */
1096 size_t send_offset = 0;
1097 size_t send_len = file->size;
1098
1099 /* --- Range Request Handling --- */
1100 const char *range_hdr = cwist_http_header_get(req->headers, "Range");
1101 if (range_hdr && strncmp(range_hdr, "bytes=", 6) == 0) {
1102 const char *p = range_hdr + 6;
1103 size_t range_start = 0, range_end = file->size - 1;
1104 bool range_valid = true;
1105
1106 if (p[0] == '-') {
1107 /* suffix-range: bytes=-N means the last N bytes */
1108 char *end = NULL;
1109 unsigned long long sv = strtoull(p + 1, &end, 10);
1110 if (end == p + 1 || *end != '\0') {
1111 range_valid = false;
1112 } else {
1113 range_start = (file->size > (size_t)sv) ? file->size - (size_t)sv : 0;
1114 range_end = file->size - 1;
1115 }
1116 } else {
1117 /* first-byte-pos [ "-" [ last-byte-pos ] ] */
1118 char *end = NULL;
1119 unsigned long long rs = strtoull(p, &end, 10);
1120 if (end == p) {
1121 range_valid = false;
1122 } else {
1123 range_start = (size_t)rs;
1124 char *dash = strchr(p, '-');
1125 if (dash && dash[1] != '\0') {
1126 unsigned long long re = strtoull(dash + 1, &end, 10);
1127 range_end = (end != dash + 1) ? (size_t)re : file->size - 1;
1128 } else {
1129 range_end = file->size - 1;
1130 }
1131 }
1132 }
1133
1134 if (!range_valid || range_start > range_end || range_start >= file->size) {
1135 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE;
1136 char cr[128];
1137 snprintf(cr, sizeof(cr), "bytes */%zu", file->size);
1138 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Content-Range", cr);
1139 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "");
1140 } else {
1141 if (range_end >= file->size) range_end = file->size - 1;
1142 send_offset = range_start;
1143 send_len = range_end - range_start + 1;
1144 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_PARTIAL_CONTENT;
1145 char cr[128];
1146 snprintf(cr, sizeof(cr), "bytes %zu-%zu/%zu", range_start, range_end,
1147 file->size);
1148 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Content-Range", cr);
1149 }
1150 }
1151
1152 if (res->status_code != CWIST_HTTP_RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE) {
1153 if (file->data && file->node) {
1154 ttak_mem_node_acquire(file->node);
1155 cwist_http_response_set_body_ptr_managed(res, (char *)file->data + send_offset,
1156 send_len, cwist_static_release_body,
1157 file->node);
1158 } else {
1159 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_INTERNAL_ERROR;
1160 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "Static buffer missing");
1161 }
1162 }
1163
1164 if (res->status_code != CWIST_HTTP_INTERNAL_ERROR &&
1165 res->status_code != CWIST_HTTP_RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE) {
1166 const char *cc = info->mapping->cache_control ? info->mapping->cache_control
1167 : "public, max-age=3600";
1168 char len_buf[32];
1169 snprintf(len_buf, sizeof(len_buf), "%zu", send_len);
1170 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Content-Length", len_buf);
1171 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Content-Type", mime);
1172 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "ETag", etag);
1173 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Last-Modified", last_mod_buf);
1174 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Cache-Control", cc);
1175 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Accept-Ranges", "bytes");
1176 if (res->status_code != CWIST_HTTP_PARTIAL_CONTENT) {
1177 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_OK;
1178 }
1179 }
1180 }
1181 } else {
1182 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_NOT_FOUND;
1183 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "Not Found");
1184 }
1185 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mem->lock);
1186}

1196static cwist_error_t cwist_app_refresh_https_context(cwist_app *app) {
1197 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
1198 if (!app || !app->cert_path || !app->key_path) {
1199 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
1200 return err;
1201 }
1202
1203 if (app->ssl_ctx) {
1204 cwist_https_destroy_context(app->ssl_ctx);
1205 app->ssl_ctx = NULL;
1206 }
1207
1208 cwist_https_options options = {.enable_http2 = app->use_https2,
1209 .enable_http3 = app->use_https3};
1210 return cwist_https_init_context_with_options(&app->ssl_ctx, app->cert_path, app->key_path,
1211 &options, app);
1212}

1214static void static_ssl_http1_handler(cwist_https_connection *conn, void *ctx);
1215static void static_ssl_http2_handler(cwist_https_connection *conn, void *ctx);

1217static void cwist_app_refresh_https_request_handler(cwist_app *app) {
1218 if (!app) return;
1219 app->https_request_handler =
1220 app->use_https2 ? static_ssl_http2_handler : static_ssl_http1_handler;
1221}

1226static cwist_error_t cwist_app_refresh_http3_context(cwist_app *app) {
1227 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
1228 if (!app) {
1229 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
1230 return err;
1231 }
1232
1233 if (app->h3_ctx) {
1234 cwist_http3_destroy_context(app->h3_ctx);
1235 app->h3_ctx = NULL;
1236 }
1237
1238 if (app->use_https3 || app->use_http3) {
1239 if (app->use_https3 && app->cert_path && app->key_path) {
1240 err = cwist_http3_init_context(&app->h3_ctx, app->cert_path, app->key_path);
1241 } else if (app->use_http3) {
1242 err = cwist_http3_init_context_ephemeral(&app->h3_ctx);
1243 } else {
1244 err.error.err_i16 = -1; // Missing config for strict https3
1245 }
1246 if (app->h3_ctx && app->wt_handler) {
1247 cwist_http3_set_webtransport_handler(app->h3_ctx, app->wt_handler);
1248 }
1249 } else {
1250 err.error.err_i16 = 0;
1251 }
1252 return err;
1253}

1260 app->port = 8080;

1263 app->use_http3 = false;
1264 app->use_https2 = false;
1265 app->use_https3 = false;
1266 app->cert_path = NULL;
1267 app->key_path = NULL;
1268 app->https_request_handler = NULL;

1271 cwist_free(app);
1272 return NULL;
1273 }
1274 app->middlewares = NULL;
1275 app->ssl_ctx = NULL;
1276 app->h3_ctx = NULL;
1277 app->error_handler = NULL;
1278 app->error_handlers = NULL;
1279 app->static_dirs = NULL;
1280 app->config = cwist_config_create();
1281 app->logger = cwist_logger_create("cwist");
1282 app->db = NULL;
1283 app->db_path = NULL;
1284 app->nuke_enabled = false;
1285 app->max_mem_space = 0;
1286 app->mem_manager = NULL;
1287 app->bdr_ctx = cwist_bdr_create();
1288 app->pqc_layer_enabled = false;
1289 app->tls_groups = NULL;
1290 app->wt_handler = NULL;
1291
1292 app->session_secret = NULL;
1293 app->session_name = NULL;
1294 app->session_max_age = 0;
1295 app->db_pool = NULL;
1296 app->redis_pool = NULL;
1297 app->scheduler = NULL;
1298 app->grpc_routes = NULL;
1299
1300#if !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) && !defined(__wasi__)
1301 cwist_app_refresh_https_request_handler(app);
1302#endif
1303
1304 return app;
1305}

1307/* Shared body of cwist_app_use() and cwist_app_use_ex(). The context is owned
1308 * by the chain from here on, including on every failure path, as with the
1309 * cwist_app_*_ex() routes. */
1310static bool add_middleware(cwist_app *app, cwist_middleware_func mw, cwist_middleware_func_ex mw_ex,
1311 void *user_ctx, cwist_middleware_ctx_destroy_func destroy) {
1312 bool valid = app && (mw != NULL) != (mw_ex != NULL);
1313 cwist_middleware_node *node = valid ? cwist_alloc(sizeof(cwist_middleware_node)) : NULL;
1314 if (!node) {
1315 if (destroy) destroy(user_ctx);
1316 return false;
1317 }
1318 node->func = mw;
1319 node->func_ex = mw_ex;
1320 node->user_ctx = user_ctx;
1321 node->destroy = destroy;
1322 node->is_ex = mw_ex != NULL;
1323 node->next = NULL;
1324
1325 if (!app->middlewares) {
1326 app->middlewares = node;
1327 } else {
1328 cwist_middleware_node *curr = app->middlewares;
1329 while (curr->next) curr = curr->next;
1330 curr->next = node;
1331 }
1332 return true;
1333}

1379void cwist_app_register_error_handler(cwist_app *app, cwist_http_status_t status,
1380 cwist_error_handler_func handler) {
1381 if (!app || !handler) return;
1382 cwist_error_handler_entry *curr = app->error_handlers;
1383 while (curr) {
1384 if (curr->status_code == status) {
1385 curr->handler = handler;
1386 return;
1387 }
1388 curr = curr->next;
1389 }
1390 cwist_error_handler_entry *entry =
1391 (cwist_error_handler_entry *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(cwist_error_handler_entry));
1392 entry->status_code = status;
1393 entry->handler = handler;
1394 entry->next = app->error_handlers;
1395 app->error_handlers = entry;
1396}
1397
1398static cwist_error_handler_func cwist_app_find_error_handler(cwist_app *app,
1399 cwist_http_status_t status) {
1400 if (!app) return NULL;
1401 cwist_error_handler_entry *curr = app->error_handlers;
1402 while (curr) {
1403 if (curr->status_code == status) {
1404 return curr->handler;
1405 }
1406 curr = curr->next;
1407 }
1408 return app->error_handler;
1409}

1428void cwist_app_destroy(cwist_app *app) {
1429 if (!app) return;
1430#if !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) && !defined(__wasi__)
1431 cwist_multiport_destroy_owned_subapps(app);
1432 cwist_multiport_unlink_app(app);
1433#endif
1434 if (app->cert_path) cwist_free(app->cert_path);
1435 if (app->key_path) cwist_free(app->key_path);
1436 if (app->tls_groups) cwist_free(app->tls_groups);
1437#if !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) && !defined(__wasi__)
1438 if (app->ssl_ctx) cwist_https_destroy_context(app->ssl_ctx);
1439 if (app->h3_ctx) cwist_http3_destroy_context(app->h3_ctx);
1440#endif
1441
1442 cwist_route_table_destroy(app->router);
1443
1444 cwist_middleware_node *curr_m = app->middlewares;
1445 while (curr_m) {
1446 cwist_middleware_node *next = curr_m->next;
1447 if (curr_m->destroy) curr_m->destroy(curr_m->user_ctx);
1448 cwist_free(curr_m);
1449 curr_m = next;
1450 }
1451
1452 cwist_error_handler_entry *curr_e = app->error_handlers;
1453 while (curr_e) {
1454 cwist_error_handler_entry *next = curr_e->next;
1455 cwist_free(curr_e);
1456 curr_e = next;
1457 }
1458
1459 if (app->config) cwist_config_destroy(app->config);
1460 if (app->logger) cwist_logger_destroy(app->logger);
1461 if (app->rdbms) {
1462 cwist_rdbms_runtime *rt = app->rdbms;
1463 if (rt->host) cwist_free(rt->host);
1464 cwist_free(rt);
1465 }
1466
1467 cwist_static_dir *curr_s = app->static_dirs;
1468 while (curr_s) {
1469 cwist_static_dir *next = curr_s->next;
1470 cwist_free(curr_s->url_prefix);
1471 cwist_free(curr_s->fs_root);
1472 cwist_free(curr_s->cache_control);
1473 cwist_free(curr_s);
1474 curr_s = next;
1475 }
1476
1477#if !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) && !defined(__wasi__)
1478 if (app->mem_manager) {
1479 app->mem_manager->watcher_running = false;
1480 // If thread was started, join it.
1481 // Note: In simple destroy we might not have started it or might be crashing, but try join.
1482 if (app->mem_manager->watcher_thread) {
1483 pthread_join(app->mem_manager->watcher_thread, NULL);
1484 }
1485 pthread_mutex_destroy(&app->mem_manager->lock);
1486
1487 for (size_t i = 0; i < app->mem_manager->file_count; i++) {
1488 cwist_free(app->mem_manager->files[i].path);
1489 cwist_free(app->mem_manager->files[i].fs_path);
1490 }
1491 for (size_t i = 0; i < app->mem_manager->file_count; i++) {
1492 if (app->mem_manager->files[i].node) {
1493 ttak_mem_tree_remove(&app->mem_manager->file_tree, app->mem_manager->files[i].node);
1494 app->mem_manager->files[i].node = NULL;
1495 }
1496 }
1497 cwist_free(app->mem_manager->files);
1498 ttak_mem_tree_destroy(&app->mem_manager->file_tree);
1499 cwist_free(app->mem_manager);
1500 }
1501#endif /* __EMSCRIPTEN__ */
1502
1503 if (app->bdr_ctx) {
1504 cwist_bdr_destroy(app->bdr_ctx);
1505 }
1506 cwist_assets_destroy(app->assets);
1507 app->assets = NULL;
1508
1509#if !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) && !defined(__wasi__)
1510 if (app->nuke_enabled) {
1511 cwist_nuke_close();
1512 }
1513
1514 if (app->db) {
1515 // If nuke was used, app->db->conn was shared with nuke.
1516 // But nuke_close already closed its handles.
1517 // However, cwist_db_close will try to close it again if we are not careful.
1518 // Actually, NukeDB is a global singleton currently, so it's a bit messy.
1519 // If nuke_enabled is true, we should probably NOT call cwist_db_close(app->db)
1520 // OR we should make sure it's safe.
1521 // Based on cwist_db_close implementation, it calls sqlite3_close.
1522 if (app->nuke_enabled) {
1523 // Just free the wrapper, don't close the conn as Nuke already did it.
1524 ttak_mem_free(app->db);
1525 } else {
1526 cwist_db_close(app->db);
1527 }
1528 app->db = NULL;
1529 }
1530#endif /* __EMSCRIPTEN__ */
1531 if (app->db_path) {
1532 cwist_free(app->db_path);
1533 }
1534
1535 if (app->session_secret) cwist_free(app->session_secret);
1536 if (app->session_name) cwist_free(app->session_name);
1537
1538#if !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) && !defined(__wasi__)
1539 if (app->db_pool) {
1540 cwist_db_pool_destroy((cwist_db_pool_t *)app->db_pool);
1541 }
1542 if (app->redis_pool) {
1543 cwist_redis_pool_destroy((cwist_redis_pool_t *)app->redis_pool);
1544 }
1545 if (app->scheduler) {
1546 cwist_scheduler_destroy((cwist_scheduler_t *)app->scheduler);
1547 }
1548 cwist_grpc_routes_destroy(app);
1549#endif /* __EMSCRIPTEN__ */
1550
1551 cwist_free(app);
1552}
1553
1559static void mw_next_wrapper(cwist_http_request *req, cwist_http_response *res) {
1560 mw_executor_ctx *ctx = (mw_executor_ctx *)req->private_data;
1561 if (!ctx) return;
1562
1563 if (ctx->current_mw_node) {
1564 cwist_middleware_node *node = ctx->current_mw_node;
1565 // Advance the chain for the next "next" call
1566 ctx->current_mw_node = node->next;
1567 if (node->is_ex) {
1568 node->func_ex(req, res, mw_next_wrapper, node->user_ctx);
1569 } else {
1570 node->func(req, res, mw_next_wrapper);
1571 }
1572 } else if (ctx->final_handler) {
1573 ctx->final_handler(req, res);
1574 }
1575}
1576
1585static void execute_chain(cwist_app *app, cwist_http_request *req, cwist_http_response *res,
1586 cwist_handler_func final_handler, void *handler_data) {
1587 mw_executor_ctx ctx = {app->middlewares, final_handler, handler_data};
1588 req->private_data = &ctx;
1589 if (__builtin_expect(!app->middlewares, 1)) {
1590 /* No middleware: still expose the executor ctx so final handlers
1591 * (e.g. the static-file handler) can reach handler_data. */
1592 if (final_handler) final_handler(req, res);
1593 } else {
1594 mw_next_wrapper(req, res);
1595 }
1596 req->private_data = NULL;
1597}

1606cwist_error_t cwist_app_use_https(cwist_app *app, const char *cert_path, const char *key_path) {
1607#if defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) || defined(__wasi__)
1608 (void)cert_path;
1609 (void)key_path;
1610 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
1611 err.error.err_i16 = -1; /* TLS needs BoringSSL sockets; native builds only */
1612 (void)app;
1613 return err;
1614#else
1615 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
1616 if (!app || !cert_path || !key_path) {
1617 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
1618 return err;
1619 }
1620
1621 app->use_ssl = true;
1622 if (app->cert_path) cwist_free(app->cert_path);
1623 if (app->key_path) cwist_free(app->key_path);
1624 app->cert_path = cwist_strdup(cert_path);
1625 app->key_path = cwist_strdup(key_path);
1626
1627 if (!app->cert_path || !app->key_path) {
1628 if (app->cert_path) {
1629 cwist_free(app->cert_path);
1630 app->cert_path = NULL;
1631 }
1632 if (app->key_path) {
1633 cwist_free(app->key_path);
1634 app->key_path = NULL;
1635 }
1636 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
1637 return err;
1638 }
1639
1640 if (app->use_https3 || app->use_http3) {
1641 cwist_app_refresh_http3_context(app);
1642 }
1643 return cwist_app_refresh_https_context(app);
1644#endif
1645}

1792cwist_error_t cwist_app_use_nuke_db(cwist_app *app, const char *db_path, int sync_interval_ms) {
1793 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
1794 if (!app || !db_path) {
1795 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
1796 return err;
1797 }
1798
1799#if defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) || defined(__wasi__)
1800 (void)sync_interval_ms;
1801 err.error.err_i16 = -1; /* NUKE DB needs native libttak memory */
1802 return err;
1803#else
1804 int nuke_rc = cwist_nuke_init(db_path, sync_interval_ms);
1805 if (nuke_rc == CWIST_NUKE_ERR_LOW_MEMORY) {
1806 fprintf(
1807 stderr,
1808 "[CWIST] Nuke DB disabled for '%s' (insufficient RAM). Falling back to standard SQLite.\n",
1809 db_path);
1810 return cwist_app_use_db(app, db_path);
1811 } else if (nuke_rc != CWIST_NUKE_OK) {
1812 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
1813 return err;
1814 }
1815
1816 if (app->db) {
1817 if (app->nuke_enabled)
1818 ttak_mem_free(app->db);
1819 else
1820 cwist_db_close(app->db);
1821 app->db = NULL;
1822 }
1823 if (app->db_path) {
1824 cwist_free(app->db_path);
1825 }
1826
1827 app->db = (cwist_db *)ttak_mem_alloc_safe(sizeof(cwist_db), __TTAK_UNSAFE_MEM_FOREVER__,
1828 cwist_mem_now(), false, false, true, true,
1829 TTAK_MEM_DEFAULT);
1830 if (!app->db) {
1831 cwist_nuke_close();
1832 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
1833 return err;
1834 }
1835 app->db->conn = cwist_nuke_get_db();
1836 app->db_path = cwist_strdup(db_path);
1837 app->nuke_enabled = true;
1838
1839 err.error.err_i16 = 0;
1840 return err;
1841#endif
1842}

1957cwist_error_t cwist_app_static(cwist_app *app, const char *url_prefix, const char *directory) {
1958 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
1959 if (!app || !url_prefix || !directory) {
1960 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
1961 return err;
1962 }
1963
1964 char *normalized = cwist_normalize_prefix(url_prefix);
1965 if (!normalized) {
1966 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
1967 return err;
1968 }
1969
1970 char *resolved = cwist_normalize_directory(directory);
1971 if (!resolved) {
1972 cwist_free(normalized);
1973 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
1974 return err;
1975 }
1976
1977 cwist_static_dir *entry = (cwist_static_dir *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(cwist_static_dir));
1978 if (!entry) {
1979 cwist_free(normalized);
1980 cwist_free(resolved);
1981 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
1982 return err;
1983 }
1984
1985 entry->url_prefix = normalized;
1986 entry->fs_root = resolved;
1987 entry->cache_control = NULL;
1988 entry->next = app->static_dirs;
1989 app->static_dirs = entry;
1990
1991 err.error.err_i16 = 0;
1992 return err;
1993}

2003cwist_error_t cwist_app_static_with_cache(cwist_app *app, const char *url_prefix,
2004 const char *directory, const char *cache_control) {
2005 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
2006 if (!app || !url_prefix || !directory || !cache_control) {
2007 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
2008 return err;
2009 }
2010
2011 char *normalized = cwist_normalize_prefix(url_prefix);
2012 if (!normalized) {
2013 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
2014 return err;
2015 }
2016
2017 char *resolved = cwist_normalize_directory(directory);
2018 if (!resolved) {
2019 cwist_free(normalized);
2020 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
2021 return err;
2022 }
2023
2024 cwist_static_dir *entry = (cwist_static_dir *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(cwist_static_dir));
2025 if (!entry) {
2026 cwist_free(normalized);
2027 cwist_free(resolved);
2028 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
2029 return err;
2030 }
2031
2032 entry->url_prefix = normalized;
2033 entry->fs_root = resolved;
2034 entry->cache_control = cwist_strdup(cache_control);
2035 if (!entry->cache_control) {
2036 cwist_free(normalized);
2037 cwist_free(resolved);
2038 cwist_free(entry);
2039 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
2040 return err;
2041 }
2042 entry->next = app->static_dirs;
2043 app->static_dirs = entry;
2044
2045 err.error.err_i16 = 0;
2046 return err;
2047}

2060/* Shared body of the cwist_app_*_ex() registrations. The context is owned by
2061 * the route table from here on, including on every failure path. */
2062static cwist_error_t add_route_ex(cwist_app *app, const char *path, cwist_http_method_t method,
2063 cwist_handler_ex_func handler, void *user_ctx,
2064 cwist_handler_ctx_destroy_func destroy) {
2065 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
2066 if (!app || !app->router || !handler) {
2067 if (destroy) destroy(user_ctx);
2068 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
2069 return err;
2070 }
2071 const cwist_route_target target = {
2072 .handler_ex = handler, .user_ctx = user_ctx, .ctx_destroy = destroy};
2073 /* On failure the table has already released the context. */
2074 bool ok =
2075 cwist_route_table_insert(app->router, path, NULL, method, &target, CWIST_ENDPOINT_DEFAULT);
2076 err.error.err_i16 = ok ? 0 : -1;
2077 return err;
2078}

2297static bool match_path(const char *pattern, const char *actual, cwist_query_map *params) {
2298 if (params) {
2299 cwist_query_map_clear(params);
2300 }
2301
2302 const char *p = pattern;
2303 const char *a = actual;
2304 for (;;) {
2305 while (*p == '/') p++;
2306 while (*a == '/') a++;
2307 if (*p == '\0' || *a == '\0') return *p == '\0' && *a == '\0';
2308
2309 const char *p_slash = strchr(p, '/');
2310 const size_t p_len = p_slash ? (size_t)(p_slash - p) : strlen(p);
2311 const char *a_slash = strchr(a, '/');
2312 const size_t a_len = a_slash ? (size_t)(a_slash - a) : strlen(a);
2313
2314 if (p[0] == ':') {
2315 if (params) {
2316 char key[256], val[256];
2317 const size_t klen = (p_len - 1 < 255) ? p_len - 1 : 255;
2318 const size_t vlen = (a_len < 255) ? a_len : 255;
2319 memcpy(key, p + 1, klen);
2320 key[klen] = '\0';
2321 memcpy(val, a, vlen);
2322 val[vlen] = '\0';
2323 cwist_query_map_set(params, key, val);
2324 }
2325 } else if (p_len != a_len || memcmp(p, a, p_len) != 0) {
2326 return false;
2327 }
2328
2329 p += p_len;
2330 a += a_len;
2331 }
2332}

2334static cwist_route_entry *cwist_route_table_find_by_name(cwist_route_table *table,
2335 const char *name) {
2336 if (!table || !name) return NULL;
2337 for (size_t i = 0; i < table->bucket_count; i++) {
2338 cwist_route_entry *curr = table->buckets[i];
2339 while (curr) {
2340 if (curr->name && strcmp(curr->name, name) == 0) return curr;
2341 curr = curr->next;
2342 }
2343 }
2344 cwist_route_entry *curr = table->param_routes;
2345 while (curr) {
2346 if (curr->name && strcmp(curr->name, name) == 0) return curr;
2347 curr = curr->next;
2348 }
2349 return NULL;
2350}
2351
2352char *cwist_url_for(cwist_app *app, const char *name, cwist_query_map *params) {
2353 if (!app || !app->router || !name) return NULL;
2354 cwist_route_entry *entry = cwist_route_table_find_by_name(app->router, name);
2355 if (!entry) return NULL;
2356 const char *path = entry->path;
2357 if (!params || !entry->has_params) {
2358 return cwist_strdup(path);
2359 }
2360 // Build URL by replacing :param segments
2361 cwist_sstring *result = cwist_sstring_create();
2362 if (!result) return NULL;
2363 char path_copy[512];
2364 strncpy(path_copy, path, sizeof(path_copy) - 1);
2365 path_copy[sizeof(path_copy) - 1] = '\0';
2366 char *saveptr;
2367 char *tok = strtok_r(path_copy, "/", &saveptr);
2368 int first = 1;
2369 while (tok) {
2370 if (!first) cwist_sstring_append(result, "/");
2371 first = 0;
2372 if (tok[0] == ':') {
2373 const char *val = cwist_query_map_get(params, tok + 1);
2374 if (val) {
2375 cwist_sstring_append(result, val);
2376 } else {
2377 cwist_sstring_append(result, tok);
2378 }
2379 } else {
2380 cwist_sstring_append(result, tok);
2381 }
2382 tok = strtok_r(NULL, "/", &saveptr);
2383 }
2384 char *out = cwist_strdup(result->data);
2385 cwist_sstring_destroy(result);
2386 return out;
2387}

2400int cwist_app_dispatch_memory(cwist_app *app, const char *req_buf, size_t req_len, char **res_buf,
2401 size_t *res_len) {
2402 if (!app || !req_buf || !res_buf || !res_len) return -1;
2403 *res_buf = NULL;
2404 *res_len = 0;
2405
2406 cwist_http_request *req = cwist_http_parse_request_len(req_buf, req_len);
2407 if (!req) return -1;
2408
2409 cwist_http_response *res = cwist_http_response_create();
2410 if (!res) {
2411 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
2412 return -1;
2413 }
2414 cwist_app_dispatch(app, req, res);
2415 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
2416
2417 /* Producer streams finalize at dispatch return when the handler did not
2418 * end them explicitly (terminator only; no sink is attached here). */
2419 if (res->stream_mode && !res->stream_ended) cwist_http_response_stream_end(res);
2420
2421 /* One-shot buffer exchange: Connection: close semantics. */
2422 res->keep_alive = false;
2423 int rc = cwist_http_response_serialize(res, res_buf, res_len);
2424 cwist_http_response_destroy(res);
2425 return rc;
2426}
2427
2428/* --- WASM boundary streaming (issue #93 Phase 3) -------------------------- */
2429
2430/* Cap on the body bytes preallocated from the declared Content-Length.
2431 * Feeds beyond this grow the buffer on demand so a bogus huge declaration
2432 * cannot force a huge allocation at begin() time. */
2433#define CWIST_STREAM_REQ_EAGER_MAX ((size_t)1 << 20)
2434
2435struct cwist_stream_req {
2436 /* Head and body share one contiguous buffer: the head sits at
2437 * [0, head_len) and fed body bytes are appended after it, so each
2438 * chunk is copied exactly once into its final wire position. */
2439 char *wire;
2440 size_t head_len;
2441 size_t content_length; /* parsed from Content-Length; 0 when absent */
2442 size_t body_len;
2443 size_t wire_cap;
2444 bool complete; /* set by a successful cwist_stream_req_end() */
2445};
2446
2447/* Case-insensitive scan of the head block for a Content-Length header.
2448 * Returns the declared length, 0 when absent, -1 on malformed values. */
2449static long cwist_stream_parse_content_length(const char *head, size_t head_len) {
2450 static const char cl_name[] = "content-length:";
2451 const char *p = head;
2452 const char *end = head + head_len;
2453 while (p + sizeof(cl_name) - 1 <= end) {
2454 size_t i = 0;
2455 while (i < sizeof(cl_name) - 1) {
2456 unsigned char c = (unsigned char)p[i];
2457 if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = (unsigned char)(c + ('a' - 'A'));
2458 if ((char)c != cl_name[i]) break;
2459 i++;
2460 }
2461 if (i == sizeof(cl_name) - 1) {
2462 const char *v = p + i;
2463 while (v < end && (*v == ' ' || *v == '\t')) v++;
2464 errno = 0;
2465 char *num_end = NULL;
2466 long n = strtol(v, &num_end, 10);
2467 if (errno != 0 || num_end == v || n < 0) return -1;
2468 return n;
2469 }
2470 /* advance to the next header line */
2471 while (p < end && *p != '\n') p++;
2472 if (p < end) p++;
2473 }
2474 return 0;
2475}
2476
2477cwist_stream_req_t *cwist_stream_req_begin(const char *head, size_t head_len) {
2478 if (!head || head_len == 0) return NULL;
2479 cwist_stream_req_t *r = cwist_alloc(sizeof(*r));
2480 if (!r) return NULL;
2481 long cl = cwist_stream_parse_content_length(head, head_len);
2482 if (cl < 0) {
2483 cwist_free(r);
2484 return NULL;
2485 }
2486 r->head_len = head_len;
2487 r->content_length = (size_t)cl;
2488 r->body_len = 0;
2489 /* Eagerly reserve the declared body when it is modest; larger bodies
2490 * grow on feed so a bogus Content-Length cannot force a big allocation. */
2491 size_t eager = (size_t)cl < CWIST_STREAM_REQ_EAGER_MAX ? (size_t)cl : 0;
2492 r->wire_cap = head_len + eager;
2493 r->wire = cwist_alloc(r->wire_cap);
2494 if (!r->wire) {
2495 cwist_free(r);
2496 return NULL;
2497 }
2498 memcpy(r->wire, head, head_len);
2499 r->complete = false;
2500 return r;
2501}
2502
2503int cwist_stream_req_feed(cwist_stream_req_t *r, const char *chunk, size_t len) {
2504 if (!r || (!chunk && len > 0)) return -1;
2505 if (len > r->content_length - r->body_len) return -1; /* overflow of declared length */
2506 if (len == 0) return 0;
2507 size_t used = r->head_len + r->body_len;
2508 if (len > r->wire_cap - used) {
2509 size_t ncap = r->wire_cap ? r->wire_cap : 4096;
2510 while (ncap - r->head_len < r->body_len + len) ncap *= 2;
2511 char *nb = cwist_alloc(ncap);
2512 if (!nb) return -1;
2513 memcpy(nb, r->wire, used);
2514 cwist_free(r->wire);
2515 r->wire = nb;
2516 r->wire_cap = ncap;
2517 }
2518 memcpy(r->wire + used, chunk, len);
2519 r->body_len += len;
2520 return 0;
2521}
2522
2523int cwist_stream_req_end(cwist_stream_req_t *r) {
2524 if (!r) return -1;
2525 if (r->body_len != r->content_length) return -1;
2526 r->complete = true;
2527 return 0;
2528}
2529
2530int cwist_stream_req_dispatch(cwist_stream_req_t *r, cwist_app *app, cwist_stream_write_fn write_fn,
2531 void *write_ctx) {
2532 if (!r) return -1;
2533 int rc;
2534 if (!app || !write_fn || !r->complete) {
2535 rc = -1;
2536 } else {
2537 rc =
2538 cwist_app_dispatch_stream(app, r->wire, r->head_len + r->body_len, write_fn, write_ctx);
2539 }
2540 cwist_free(r->wire);
2541 cwist_free(r);
2542 return rc;
2543}
2544
2545int cwist_app_dispatch_stream(cwist_app *app, const char *req_buf, size_t req_len,
2546 cwist_stream_write_fn write_fn, void *write_ctx) {
2547 if (!app || !req_buf || !write_fn) return -1;
2548
2549 cwist_http_request *req = cwist_http_parse_request_len(req_buf, req_len);
2550 if (!req) return -1;
2551
2552 cwist_http_response *res = cwist_http_response_create();
2553 if (!res) {
2554 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
2555 return -1;
2556 }
2557 /* Attach the sink before dispatch: producer writes stream head-first
2558 * and chunk-by-chunk while the handler is still running. */
2559 res->stream_sink = write_fn;
2560 res->stream_sink_ctx = write_ctx;
2561 cwist_app_dispatch(app, req, res);
2562 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
2563 res->keep_alive = false;
2564
2565 if (res->stream_mode) {
2566 /* Finalize an un-ended stream (flushes the terminator through the
2567 * sink), then detach: everything already travelled to write_fn. */
2568 if (!res->stream_ended) cwist_http_response_stream_end(res);
2569 res->stream_sink = NULL;
2570 cwist_http_response_destroy(res);
2571 return res->stream_failed ? -2 : 0;
2572 }
2573 res->stream_sink = NULL;
2574
2575 if (res->use_file_stream) {
2576 /* File-stream bodies are not resident memory; the streaming boundary
2577 * handles the same in-memory shapes as dispatch_memory. */
2578 cwist_http_response_destroy(res);
2579 return -1;
2580 }
2581
2582 char head_buf[CWIST_HTTP_MAX_HEADER_SIZE];
2583 size_t head_len = cwist_http_serialize_headers(res, head_buf, sizeof(head_buf));
2584 if (head_len == 0 || head_len >= sizeof(head_buf)) {
2585 cwist_http_response_destroy(res);
2586 return -1;
2587 }
2588 if (write_fn(write_ctx, head_buf, head_len) != 0) {
2589 cwist_http_response_destroy(res);
2590 return -2;
2591 }
2592
2593 const void *body_ptr = NULL;
2594 size_t body_len = 0;
2595 if (res->is_ptr_body) {
2596 body_ptr = res->ptr_body;
2597 body_len = res->ptr_body_len;
2598 } else if (res->body && res->body->data) {
2599 body_ptr = res->body->data;
2600 body_len = res->body->size;
2601 }
2602 int rc = 0;
2603 size_t off = 0;
2604 while (off < body_len) {
2605 size_t n = body_len - off;
2606 if (n > CWIST_STREAM_CHUNK) n = CWIST_STREAM_CHUNK;
2607 if (write_fn(write_ctx, (const char *)body_ptr + off, n) != 0) {
2608 rc = -2;
2609 break;
2610 }
2611 off += n;
2612 }
2613 cwist_http_response_destroy(res);
2614 return rc;
2615}
2616
2617// Internal Router Logic
2621static void cwist_asset_handler(cwist_http_request *req, cwist_http_response *res) {
2622 mw_executor_ctx *ctx = (mw_executor_ctx *)req->private_data;
2623 cwist_assets_respond(req, res, ctx ? (const cwist_asset_match *)ctx->handler_data : NULL);
2624}
2625
2626/* Final handler for cwist_app_*_ex() routes: execute_route() passes the route
2627 * entry as handler_data, which the middleware executor keeps reachable. */
2628static void cwist_route_ex_handler(cwist_http_request *req, cwist_http_response *res) {
2629 mw_executor_ctx *ctx = (mw_executor_ctx *)req->private_data;
2630 cwist_route_entry *route = ctx ? (cwist_route_entry *)ctx->handler_data : NULL;
2631 if (route && route->handler_ex) route->handler_ex(route->user_ctx, req, res);
2632}
2633
2634static void execute_route(cwist_app *app, cwist_http_request *req, cwist_http_response *res,
2635 cwist_route_entry *route) {
2636 if (route->handler_ex) {
2637 execute_chain(app, req, res, cwist_route_ex_handler, route);
2638 } else {
2639 execute_chain(app, req, res, route->handler, NULL);
2640 }
2641}
2642
2643static void internal_route_handler(cwist_app *app, cwist_http_request *req,
2644 cwist_http_response *res) {
2645 if (!req || !app || !app->router) return;
2646
2647 req->endpoint_opts = CWIST_ENDPOINT_DEFAULT;
2648 if (res) {
2649 res->endpoint_opts = req->endpoint_opts;
2650 }
2651
2652 const char *path = (req->path && req->path->data) ? req->path->data : "/";
2653 cwist_route_entry *found_route = cwist_route_table_lookup(app->router, req->method, path);
2654
2655 if (found_route) {
2656 req->endpoint_opts = found_route->opts ? found_route->opts : CWIST_ENDPOINT_DEFAULT;
2657 if (res) res->endpoint_opts = req->endpoint_opts;
2658 if (found_route->ws_async_on_message && req->async_conn) {
2659#if !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) && !defined(__wasi__)
2660 /* C1M path (issue #181): the route handler runs on the reactor
2661 * thread, so invoking a blocking ws_handler here would park the
2662 * whole worker in recv(). Complete the upgrade, send the 101
2663 * through the coalesced writer, then hand the fd to the
2664 * reactor-driven callback-shaped WebSocket path. */
2665 if (cwist_websocket_upgrade_response(req, res)) {
2666 cwist_http_async_conn_t *aconn = (cwist_http_async_conn_t *)req->async_conn;
2667 req->upgraded = true;
2668 res->keep_alive = true;
2669 cwist_http_send_response_coalesced(req->client_fd, res, aconn, false, false);
2670 cwist_http_coalesce_flush_blocking(req->client_fd, aconn);
2671 if (cwist_websocket_async_attach(req->client_fd, aconn->reactor,
2672 found_route->ws_async_on_message,
2673 found_route->ws_async_user_data,
2674 (const uint8_t *)aconn->rbuf, aconn->len)) {
2675 /* Bytes already read past the upgrade request were
2676 * copied into the WS stash by attach. The HTTP layer
2677 * releases the connection shell (without closing the fd)
2678 * when the C1M loop reports CWIST_ASYNC_DETACH on
2679 * req->ws_async_handoff; the WS async state owns the fd
2680 * from here on. */
2681 req->async_conn = NULL;
2682 req->ws_async_handoff = true;
2683 } else {
2684 /* 101 already sent and attach closed the fd; detach so
2685 * the HTTP layer only releases the connection shell. */
2686 req->async_conn = NULL;
2687 req->ws_async_handoff = true;
2688 }
2689 } else {
2690 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_BAD_REQUEST;
2691 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "WebSocket Upgrade Failed");
2692 }
2693#endif
2694 } else if (found_route->ws_handler) {
2695#if defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) || defined(__wasi__)
2696 /* WebSocket upgrades need a live socket; in-memory dispatch has none. */
2697 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_BAD_REQUEST;
2698 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "WebSocket Upgrade Failed");
2699#else
2700 if (req->client_fd >= 0) {
2701 cwist_websocket *ws = cwist_websocket_upgrade(req, req->client_fd);
2702 if (ws) {
2703 found_route->ws_handler(ws);
2704 cwist_websocket_destroy(ws);
2705 } else {
2706 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_BAD_REQUEST;
2707 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "WebSocket Upgrade Failed");
2708 }
2709 }
2710#endif
2711 } else if (found_route->ws_async_on_message) {
2712 /* Callback-shaped WS routes are C1M-only; classic mode keeps the
2713 * blocking cwist_websocket_receive() API via cwist_app_ws(). */
2714 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_NOT_IMPLEMENTED;
2715 cwist_sstring_assign(res->status_text, "Not Implemented");
2716 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "WebSocket async handler requires C1M mode");
2717 } else {
2718 execute_route(app, req, res, found_route);
2719 }
2720 return;
2721 }
2722
2723 if (!found_route) {
2724 found_route = cwist_route_table_match_params(app->router, req);
2725 }
2726
2727 if (found_route) {
2728 req->endpoint_opts = found_route->opts ? found_route->opts : CWIST_ENDPOINT_DEFAULT;
2729 if (res) res->endpoint_opts = req->endpoint_opts;
2730 execute_route(app, req, res, found_route);
2731 return;
2732 }
2733
2734 /* In-memory assets need no filesystem, so unlike static directories they
2735 * are served on WASM hosts too. */
2736 cwist_asset_match asset_match = {0};
2737 if (cwist_assets_match(app, req, &asset_match)) {
2738 req->endpoint_opts = CWIST_ENDPOINT_FILE;
2739 if (res) res->endpoint_opts = req->endpoint_opts;
2740 execute_chain(app, req, res, cwist_asset_handler, &asset_match);
2741 return;
2742 }
2743
2744 cwist_static_request_info static_info = {0};
2745 if (cwist_prepare_static(app, req, &static_info)) {
2746#if !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) && !defined(__wasi__)
2747 req->endpoint_opts = CWIST_ENDPOINT_FILE;
2748 if (res) res->endpoint_opts = req->endpoint_opts;
2749 execute_chain(app, req, res, cwist_static_handler, &static_info);
2750 return;
2751#else
2752 /* Unreachable: cwist_prepare_static() always declines on WASM hosts,
2753 * and the filesystem-backed handler is not compiled in. Guarded so
2754 * the native-only handler reference stays out of the WASM link. */
2755 return;
2756#endif
2757 }
2758
2759 cwist_error_handler_func eh = cwist_app_find_error_handler(app, CWIST_HTTP_NOT_FOUND);
2760 if (eh) {
2761 eh(req, res, CWIST_HTTP_NOT_FOUND);
2762 } else {
2763 res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_NOT_FOUND;
2764 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "404 Not Found");
2765 }
2766}

2772 cwist_http_response *res) {

2789#ifndef __wasi__
2790/* TLS connection handlers: BoringSSL is not linked on WASI, and the only
2791 * call sites (cwist_app_listen's SSL branch, multiport) are compiled out
2792 * there. */
2793static void static_ssl_handler(cwist_https_connection *conn, void *ctx) {
2794 cwist_app *app = (cwist_app *)ctx;
2795 if (!app || !conn) return;
2796
2797 if (cwist_https_connection_uses_http2(conn)) {
2798 static_ssl_http2_handler(conn, ctx);
2799 return;
2800 }
2801
2802 static_ssl_http1_handler(conn, ctx);
2803}
2804
2805/* Optional hook for applications that need to take ownership of a
2806 * TLS-upgraded connection (e.g. reverse-session hijacking). The no-op
2807 * default lives in src/net/http/https_upgrade_hook.c and is overridden by
2808 * any strong definition from the embedding application at static link
2809 * time. Return true to detach the fd/ssl from cwist so they are not closed
2810 * after the response is sent. */
2811bool cwist_https_upgrade_handler(cwist_https_connection *conn, cwist_http_request *req,
2812 cwist_http_response *res);
2813
2814static void static_ssl_http1_handler(cwist_https_connection *conn, void *ctx) {
2815 cwist_app *app = (cwist_app *)ctx;
2816
2817 /* HTTP/1.1 keep-alive loop: previously every request paid a full TCP
2818 * accept + TLS handshake + teardown because the connection closed after
2819 * a single response. cwist_https_receive_request bounds each header read
2820 * with CWIST_HTTP_HEADERS_TIMEOUT_MS, so idle keep-alive connections are
2821 * reaped automatically. */
2822 while (true) {
2823 /* Nothing to read: hand the connection to the park set instead of
2824 * holding this pool thread in the header read's poll(). */
2825 if (cwist_https_conn_idle(conn) &&
2826 cwist_https_park(conn, cwist_https_idle_timeout_ms(), CWIST_HTTPS_PARK_HTTP1))
2827 return;
2828 cwist_http_request *req = cwist_https_receive_request(conn);
2829 if (!req) return;
2830 req->app = app;
2831 req->db = app->db;
2832 req->https_conn = conn;
2833
2834 cwist_http_response *res = cwist_http_response_create_in_arena(req->arena);
2835 if (!res) {
2836 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
2837 return;
2838 }
2839 internal_route_handler(app, req, res);
2840
2841 /* Deferred-response handoff: ownership of req/res and conn moved to cwist_async */
2842 if (res->deferred) {
2843 cwist_async_dispatch_ack((cwist_async *)res->async);
2844 return;
2845 }
2846
2847 bool keep_alive = req->keep_alive && res->keep_alive;
2848 bool upgraded = req->upgraded;
2849
2850 /* During shutdown, answer in flight but mark the connection as
2851 * closing so the client does not race another request onto it. */
2852 if (!atomic_load(&g_cwist_running)) {
2853 res->keep_alive = false;
2854 keep_alive = false;
2855 }
2856
2857 if (req->method == CWIST_HTTP_HEAD) {
2858 cwist_https_send_response_head(conn, res);
2859 } else {
2860 cwist_https_send_response(conn, res);
2861 }
2862
2863 bool detached = false;
2864 if (upgraded) {
2865 detached = cwist_https_upgrade_handler(conn, req, res);
2866 if (detached) {
2867 conn->ssl = NULL;
2868 conn->fd = -1;
2869 }
2870 }
2871
2872 cwist_http_response_destroy(res);
2873 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
2874
2875 if (!keep_alive || upgraded) return;
2876 }
2877}
2878
2879static void static_ssl_http2_handler(cwist_https_connection *conn, void *ctx) {
2880 cwist_app *app = (cwist_app *)ctx;
2881 if (!cwist_https_connection_uses_http2(conn)) {
2882 static_ssl_http1_handler(conn, ctx);
2883 return;
2884 }
2885
2886 cwist_error_t err = cwist_http2_serve_connection_ex(conn, app, static_http2_route_bridge,
2887 cwist_grpc_http2_hooks());
2888 if (err.errtype == CWIST_ERR_JSON && err.error.err_json) {
2889 cJSON_Delete(err.error.err_json);
2890 }
2891}
2892#endif /* __wasi__ (TLS handlers need BoringSSL) */
