2898static int app_parse_error_status(cwist_http_parse_error_t perr) {
2899 switch (perr) {
2900 case CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_MALFORMED: return 400;
2901 case CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_BODY_TOO_LARGE: return 413;
2902 case CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_EXPECT_FAILED: return 417;
2903 case CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_HEADER_OVERFLOW: return 431;
2904 case CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_TE_UNSUPPORTED: return 501;
2905 default: return 0;
2906 }
2907}
2908
2909static void app_maybe_send_parse_error(int client_fd, cwist_http_parse_error_t perr) {
2910 int status = app_parse_error_status(perr);
2911 if (status > 0) {
2912 cwist_http_send_error_response(client_fd, status, NULL);
2913 }
2914}
2915
2916/* Async variant: the error goes through the coalescing stash so it cannot
2917 * overtake responses buffered earlier in the same batch turn. */
2918static void app_maybe_send_parse_error_async(cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn,
2919 cwist_http_parse_error_t perr) {
2920 int status = app_parse_error_status(perr);
2921 if (status > 0) {
2922 (void)cwist_http_coalesce_error_response(conn, status);
2923 }
2924}
2925
2926/* Flush the coalescing stash at a batch-turn exit. A parked remainder owns
2927 * fd/conn from here (it re-arms or closes after draining), so the caller
2928 * must leave both untouched. */
2929static cwist_async_action_t app_async_flush_exit(int client_fd, cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn,
2930 cwist_async_action_t action, bool keep_alive) {
2931 static _Atomic long dbg_parked;
2932 static _Atomic int dbg_cached = -1;
2933 int d = atomic_load_explicit(&dbg_cached, memory_order_relaxed);
2934 if (d < 0) {
2935 d = getenv("CWIST_ASYNC_DEBUG") != NULL;
2936 atomic_store_explicit(&dbg_cached, d, memory_order_relaxed);
2937 }
2938 cwist_coalesce_flush_status_t fs = cwist_http_coalesce_flush(client_fd, conn, keep_alive);
2939 if (fs == CWIST_COALESCE_FLUSH_PARKED) {
2940 if (d) {
2941 long n = atomic_fetch_add(&dbg_parked, 1) + 1;
2942 if (n <= 5 || n % 10000 == 0)
2943 fprintf(stderr, "[async] flush-parked fd=%d total=%ld\n", client_fd, n);
2944 }
2945 return CWIST_ASYNC_DEFER;
2946 }
2947 if (fs == CWIST_COALESCE_FLUSH_ERROR) return CWIST_ASYNC_CLOSE;
2948 return action;
2949}
2950
2955typedef enum {
2956 APP_SERVE_CLOSE = 0, /* Close the connection. */
2957 APP_SERVE_KEEPALIVE, /* Connection stays open. */
2958 APP_SERVE_DEFERRED, /* Handler deferred via cwist_async_defer; skip everything. */
2959 APP_SERVE_DETACH /* Upgraded fd handed to another owner (WS async); do not close or re-arm. */
2960} app_serve_result_t;
2961
2962#ifndef CWIST_WASI_NO_SOCKETS
2963/* Socket-server request serving: preview1 hosts dispatch in memory instead. */
2964static app_serve_result_t app_serve_parsed_request(cwist_app *app, int client_fd,
2965 cwist_http_request *req,
2966 uint32_t priority_weight) {
2967 // --- Big Dumb Reply (Read) ---
2968 if (app->bdr_ctx && req->method == CWIST_HTTP_GET) {
2969 size_t cached_len = 0;
2970 bdr_blob_t *bdr_pin = NULL;
2971 const void *cached_blob;
2972 if (req->async_conn) {
2973 /* Keep-alive connections repeat the same route: the per-connection
2974 * cursor turns the lookup into a content-compare + epoch-validated
2975 * entry reuse instead of a SipHash + bucket walk per request. */
2976 cwist_http_async_conn_t *aconn = req->async_conn;
2977 cached_blob = cwist_bdr_get_pinned_cursor(app->bdr_ctx, "GET", req->path->data,
2978 req->path->size, &cached_len, &bdr_pin,
2979 &aconn->bdr_cursor);
2980 } else {
2981 cached_blob =
2982 cwist_bdr_get_pinned(app->bdr_ctx, "GET", req->path->data, &cached_len, &bdr_pin);
2983 }
2984 if (cached_blob && cached_len > 0) {
2985 bool keep_alive = req->keep_alive;
2986 if (req->async_conn) {
2987 cwist_http_async_conn_t *aconn = req->async_conn;
2988 if (cached_len > CWIST_HTTP_COALESCE_MAX ||
2989 aconn->olen + cached_len > CWIST_HTTP_COALESCE_MAX) {
2990 if (cwist_http_coalesce_flush_blocking(client_fd, aconn) != 0) {
2991 cwist_bdr_unpin(bdr_pin);
2992 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
2993 return APP_SERVE_CLOSE;
2994 }
2995 }
2996 if (cached_len > CWIST_HTTP_COALESCE_MAX) {
2997 send(client_fd, cached_blob, cached_len, MSG_NOSIGNAL);
2998 } else if (cwist_http_coalesce_append(aconn, cached_blob, cached_len) != 0) {
2999 cwist_bdr_unpin(bdr_pin);
3000 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
3001 return APP_SERVE_CLOSE;
3002 }
3003 } else {
3004 send(client_fd, cached_blob, cached_len, MSG_NOSIGNAL);
3005 }
3006 cwist_bdr_unpin(bdr_pin);
3007 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
3008 return keep_alive ? APP_SERVE_KEEPALIVE : APP_SERVE_CLOSE;
3009 }
3010 if (bdr_pin) cwist_bdr_unpin(bdr_pin);
3011 }
3012 // -----------------------------
3013
3014 /* Share the request arena: saves one arena create/destroy per request and
3015 * the response is always destroyed just before the request below. */
3016 cwist_http_response *res = cwist_http_response_create_in_arena(req->arena);
3017 if (!res) {
3018 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
3019 return APP_SERVE_CLOSE;
3020 }
3021
3022 bool endpoint_fixed = cwist_endpoint_has(req->endpoint_opts, CWIST_ENDPOINT_FIXED);
3023 struct timespec start, end;
3024 uint64_t duration_ms = 0;
3025 if (app->bdr_ctx && !endpoint_fixed) {
3026 clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &start);
3027 }
3028
3029 internal_route_handler(app, req, res);
3030
3031 /* Deferred-response handoff: ownership of req/res (and the connection)
3032 * moved to the cwist_async completion path. Skip the send, BDR learning,
3033 * and both destroys; ack before returning so the completion may free.
3034 * The completion writes out-of-band, so coalesced responses buffered
3035 * from earlier requests in this turn must drain first to preserve
3036 * response order -- do that before the ack, because once the completion
3037 * may run it owns the fd/conn. On flush failure the connection is dead,
3038 * but req/res ownership already moved to the cwist_async, so closing
3039 * here would leave the completion holding a dangling conn/fd (UAF, and
3040 * the response bytes could land on an unrelated fd reuse). Hand the
3041 * teardown to the completion instead: ack, then abort it; the abort
3042 * response send fails on the dead connection and the completion's
3043 * send-response path closes the conn, which owns close in all outcomes. */
3044 if (res->deferred) {
3045 cwist_http_async_conn_t *aconn = (cwist_http_async_conn_t *)req->async_conn;
3046 bool broken = aconn && aconn->olen > 0 &&
3047 cwist_http_coalesce_flush_blocking(client_fd, aconn) != 0;
3048 cwist_async_dispatch_ack((cwist_async *)res->async);
3049 if (broken) cwist_async_abort((cwist_async *)res->async, CWIST_HTTP_INTERNAL_ERROR);
3050 return APP_SERVE_DEFERRED;
3051 }
3052
3053 /* WebSocket async handoff (issue #181): the 101 was sent and the fd was
3054 * handed to the reactor-driven WS path inside internal_route_handler.
3055 * The HTTP layer must neither close nor re-arm it. */
3056 if (req->ws_async_handoff) {
3057 cwist_http_response_destroy(res);
3058 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
3059 return APP_SERVE_DETACH;
3060 }
3061
3062 if (app->bdr_ctx && !endpoint_fixed) {
3063 clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &end);
3064 duration_ms = (end.tv_sec - start.tv_sec) * 1000 + (end.tv_nsec - start.tv_nsec) / 1000000;
3065 }
3066
3067 bool keep_alive = req->keep_alive && res->keep_alive;
3068 bool upgraded = req->upgraded;
3069
3070 /* During shutdown, answer in flight but mark the connection as closing
3071 * so the client does not race another request onto it. */
3072 if (!atomic_load(&g_cwist_running)) {
3073 res->keep_alive = false;
3074 keep_alive = false;
3075 }
3076
3077 if (!upgraded) {
3078 if (req->async_conn) {
3079 cwist_async_send_status_t as_st = cwist_http_send_response_coalesced(
3080 client_fd, res, req->async_conn, keep_alive, req->method == CWIST_HTTP_HEAD);
3081 cwist_http_response_destroy(res);
3082 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
3083 if (as_st == CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_DEFERRED) return APP_SERVE_DEFERRED;
3084 if (as_st == CWIST_ASYNC_SEND_KEEPALIVE) return APP_SERVE_KEEPALIVE;
3085 return APP_SERVE_CLOSE;
3086 }
3087
3088 /* RFC 9110 section 9.3.2: HEAD replies carry the GET headers (Content-Length
3089 * included) but no body bytes, for every route. */
3090 cwist_error_t send_err = (req->method == CWIST_HTTP_HEAD)
3091 ? cwist_http_send_response_head(client_fd, res)
3092 : cwist_http_send_response(client_fd, res);
3093 if (send_err.error.err_i16 < 0) {
3094 cwist_http_response_destroy(res);
3095 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
3096 return APP_SERVE_CLOSE;
3097 }
3098
3099 // --- Big Dumb Reply (Learn) ---
3100 if (app->bdr_ctx) {
3101 bool endpoint_file = cwist_endpoint_has(req->endpoint_opts, CWIST_ENDPOINT_FILE);
3102
3103 uint64_t scaled_threshold = (uint64_t)app->bdr_ctx->latency_threshold_ms;
3104 if (priority_weight > 50) {
3105 scaled_threshold = scaled_threshold * (100 - priority_weight) / 100;
3106 }
3107
3108 /* A response that declares Vary differs by request headers the
3109 * path-keyed cache cannot see (e.g. fragment vs full page), so
3110 * replaying it for another request would be wrong. */
3111 bool varies = cwist_http_header_get(res->headers, "Vary") != NULL;
3112 if (req->method == CWIST_HTTP_GET && !endpoint_file && !varies) {
3113 if (endpoint_fixed) {
3114 cwist_sstring *serialized = cwist_http_stringify_response(res);
3115 if (serialized) {
3116 cwist_bdr_put_fixed(app->bdr_ctx, "GET", req->path->data, serialized->data,
3117 serialized->size);
3118 cwist_sstring_destroy(serialized);
3119 }
3120 } else if (duration_ms > scaled_threshold) {
3121 cwist_sstring *serialized = cwist_http_stringify_response(res);
3122 if (serialized) {
3123 cwist_bdr_put(app->bdr_ctx, "GET", req->path->data, serialized->data,
3124 serialized->size);
3125 cwist_sstring_destroy(serialized);
3126 }
3127 }
3128 }
3129 }
3130 // ------------------------------
3131 }
3132
3133 cwist_http_response_destroy(res);
3134 cwist_http_request_destroy(req);
3135
3136 return (keep_alive && !upgraded) ? APP_SERVE_KEEPALIVE : APP_SERVE_CLOSE;
3137}
3138#endif /* __wasi__ */
3139
3145#define CWIST_HTTP_REQUESTS_PER_TURN_DEFAULT 16
3146#define CWIST_HTTP_REQUESTS_PER_TURN_MAX 1024
3147
3148/* Requests served per reactor callback before yielding to other connections.
3149 * CWIST_HTTP_BATCH overrides the default; values are clamped to [1, 1024]. */
3150static unsigned int app_http_requests_per_turn(void) {
3151 static _Atomic int cached = -1;
3152 int v = atomic_load_explicit(&cached, memory_order_relaxed);
3153 if (v < 0) {
3154 const char *env = getenv("CWIST_HTTP_BATCH");
3155 long parsed = env ? strtol(env, NULL, 10) : 0;
3156 if (parsed < 1) parsed = CWIST_HTTP_REQUESTS_PER_TURN_DEFAULT;
3157 if (parsed > CWIST_HTTP_REQUESTS_PER_TURN_MAX) parsed = CWIST_HTTP_REQUESTS_PER_TURN_MAX;
3158 v = (int)parsed;
3159 atomic_store_explicit(&cached, v, memory_order_relaxed);
3160 }
3161 return (unsigned int)v;
3162}
3163
3164/* Yield granularity inside one batch: after this many served requests, if
3165 * pipelined bytes remain buffered the loop exits early and the continuation
3166 * path (cwist_http_async_rearm, http.c) reposts the connection so other
3167 * ready connections run first. Defaults to the full batch (legacy behavior);
3168 * CWIST_HTTP_YIELD_BATCH overrides, clamped to [1, 1024]. */
3169static unsigned int app_http_yield_batch(void) {
3170 static _Atomic int cached = -1;
3171 int v = atomic_load_explicit(&cached, memory_order_relaxed);
3172 if (v < 0) {
3173 const char *env = getenv("CWIST_HTTP_YIELD_BATCH");
3174 long parsed = env ? strtol(env, NULL, 10) : 0;
3175 if (parsed < 1) parsed = app_http_requests_per_turn();
3176 if (parsed > CWIST_HTTP_REQUESTS_PER_TURN_MAX) parsed = CWIST_HTTP_REQUESTS_PER_TURN_MAX;
3177 v = (int)parsed;
3178 atomic_store_explicit(&cached, v, memory_order_relaxed);
3179 }
3180 return (unsigned int)v;
3181}
3182
3183#ifndef CWIST_WASI_NO_SOCKETS
3184/* h2c connection handoff: the blocking HTTP/2 server runs on a detached
3185 * thread per connection so an abandoned connection's idle poll never pins
3186 * a reactor loop. Owns the fd, the sniffed-byte replay, and the app. */
3187#define CWIST_H2C_THREAD_STACK_SIZE (256 * 1024)
3188
3189typedef struct {
3190 int fd;
3191 char *replay;
3192 size_t replay_len;
3193 cwist_app *app;
3194} h2c_handoff_t;
3195
3196static void *h2c_handoff_main(void *arg) {
3197 h2c_handoff_t *h = (h2c_handoff_t *)arg;
3198 cwist_https_connection h2c = {.fd = h->fd,
3199 .ssl = NULL,
3200 .read_buf = h->replay,
3201 .buf_len = h->replay_len,
3202 .negotiated_http2 = true,
3203 .negotiated_protocol = CWIST_HTTPS_PROTOCOL_HTTP2};
3204 cwist_http2_serve_connection_ex(&h2c, h->app, static_http2_route_bridge,
3205 cwist_grpc_http2_hooks());
3206 close(h->fd);
3207 cwist_free(h->replay);
3208 cwist_free(h);
3209 return NULL;
3210}
3211
3212cwist_async_action_t cwist_app_http_handler_async(int client_fd, cwist_http_async_conn_t *conn) {
3213 cwist_app *app = (cwist_app *)conn->user_ctx;
3214 static _Atomic long dbg_fill_fail, dbg_fatal, dbg_serve_close;
3215 /* getenv walks the whole environ vector; cache it instead of paying a
3216 * scan on every event. The racy recompute is benign (same result). */
3217 static _Atomic int dbg_cached = -1;
3218 int d = atomic_load_explicit(&dbg_cached, memory_order_relaxed);
3219 if (d < 0) {
3220 d = getenv("CWIST_ASYNC_DEBUG") != NULL;
3221 atomic_store_explicit(&dbg_cached, d, memory_order_relaxed);
3222 }
3223 const bool dbg = d != 0;
3224
3225 if (cwist_http_async_conn_fill(conn) != 0) {
3226 if (dbg) {
3227 long n = atomic_fetch_add(&dbg_fill_fail, 1) + 1;
3228 if (n <= 5 || n % 10000 == 0)
3229 fprintf(stderr,
3230 "[async] fill-fail fd=%d total=%ld fatal=%ld serve=%ld errno=%d len=%zu\n",
3231 client_fd, n, atomic_load(&dbg_fatal), atomic_load(&dbg_serve_close), errno,
3232 conn->len);
3233 }
3234 return CWIST_ASYNC_CLOSE;
3235 }
3236
3237 /* h2c preface: hand the whole connection to the blocking HTTP/2 server on
3238 * a dedicated thread. The h2 serve loop waits in poll() for up to the
3239 * idle budget (300 s default) on a connection the peer has abandoned --
3240 * running it inline here would pin this reactor for that long, and every
3241 * other connection on the loop would stall behind it (surfaced as h2spec
3242 * error-response timeouts cascading once a loop was pinned). The thread
3243 * owns fd and replay; the reactor never touches either again (DETACH). */
3244 if (app->use_http2 && conn->len >= 24 &&
3245 memcmp(conn->rbuf, "PRI * HTTP/2.0\r\n\r\nSM\r\n\r\n", 24) == 0) {
3246 char *replay = cwist_alloc(conn->len);
3247 h2c_handoff_t *handoff = replay ? cwist_alloc(sizeof(*handoff)) : NULL;
3248 if (handoff) {
3249 pthread_t tid;
3250 pthread_attr_t attr;
3251 pthread_attr_init(&attr);
3252 pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&attr, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
3253 /* The h2 serve loop's stack need is shallow; cap the reservation
3254 * like the classic pool does so a burst of h2c connections cannot
3255 * reserve 8 MiB apiece. */
3256 if (pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, CWIST_H2C_THREAD_STACK_SIZE) != 0)
3257 pthread_attr_init(&attr);
3258 int rc;
3259 memcpy(replay, conn->rbuf, conn->len);
3260 handoff->fd = client_fd;
3261 handoff->replay = replay;
3262 handoff->replay_len = conn->len;
3263 handoff->app = app;
3264 rc = pthread_create(&tid, &attr, h2c_handoff_main, handoff);
3265 pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
3266 if (rc == 0) return CWIST_ASYNC_DETACH;
3267 cwist_free(handoff);
3268 }
3269 /* Thread creation failed: preserve the old inline behavior rather
3270 * than dropping the connection. */
3271 if (replay) {
3272 memcpy(replay, conn->rbuf, conn->len);
3273 cwist_https_connection h2c = {.fd = client_fd,
3274 .ssl = NULL,
3275 .read_buf = replay,
3276 .buf_len = conn->len,
3277 .negotiated_http2 = true,
3278 .negotiated_protocol = CWIST_HTTPS_PROTOCOL_HTTP2};
3279 cwist_http2_serve_connection_ex(&h2c, app, static_http2_route_bridge,
3280 cwist_grpc_http2_hooks());
3281 cwist_free(replay);
3282 }
3283 close(client_fd);
3284 return CWIST_ASYNC_DETACH;
3285 }
3286
3287 /* Apply Choi Seok-jeong's Lattice (Sanpan) for priority scaling. */
3288 uint32_t tid = ttak_net_lattice_get_worker_id();
3289 uint16_t node_id = (uint16_t)(client_fd % TTAK_MOLS_NODE_COUNT);
3290 uint32_t mixed_seed = ttak_apply_mols_control(node_id, tid);
3291
3292 /* Jeungseung Gaebang Scaling for priority weighting. */
3293 uint32_t priority_weight = ((mixed_seed * 16777619U) >> 8) % 100;
3294
3295 /* One pipeline must not monopolize this reactor's other connections. */
3296 const unsigned int yield_batch = app_http_yield_batch();
3297 for (unsigned int handled = 0; handled < app_http_requests_per_turn(); ++handled) {
3298 cwist_http_request *req = NULL;
3299 cwist_http_parse_error_t perr = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_OK;
3300 cwist_recv_status_t st = cwist_http_receive_request_nb(conn, &req, &perr);
3301 if (st == CWIST_RECV_NEED_MORE) {
3302 /* EOF with no complete frame must close, not wait or repost. */
3303 return app_async_flush_exit(client_fd, conn,
3304 conn->peer_eof ? CWIST_ASYNC_CLOSE : CWIST_ASYNC_REARM,
3305 !conn->peer_eof);
3306 }
3307 if (st == CWIST_RECV_FATAL) {
3308 app_maybe_send_parse_error_async(conn, perr);
3309 if (dbg) {
3310 long n = atomic_fetch_add(&dbg_fatal, 1) + 1;
3311 if (n <= 5 || n % 10000 == 0)
3312 fprintf(stderr, "[async] recv-fatal fd=%d total=%ld len=%zu\n", client_fd, n,
3313 conn->len);
3314 }
3315 return app_async_flush_exit(client_fd, conn, CWIST_ASYNC_CLOSE, false);
3316 }
3317 req->client_fd = client_fd;
3318 req->app = app;
3319 req->db = app->db;
3320 req->async_conn = conn;
3321 app_serve_result_t sr = app_serve_parsed_request(app, client_fd, req, priority_weight);
3322 /* Deferred: buffered coalesced responses from this turn already
3323 * drained inside app_serve_parsed_request, before the defer was
3324 * acked; the completion path owns the fd/conn now (it re-arms or
3325 * closes, including the flush-failure abort). Nothing to do here. */
3326 if (sr == APP_SERVE_DEFERRED) {
3327 return CWIST_ASYNC_DEFER;
3328 }
3329 if (sr == APP_SERVE_DETACH) {
3330 /* fd ownership moved (WebSocket async upgrade, issue #181); the
3331 * HTTP layer must not close or re-arm it. */
3332 return CWIST_ASYNC_DETACH;
3333 }
3334 if (sr == APP_SERVE_CLOSE) {
3335 if (dbg) {
3336 long n = atomic_fetch_add(&dbg_serve_close, 1) + 1;
3337 if (n <= 5 || n % 10000 == 0)
3338 fprintf(stderr, "[async] serve-close fd=%d total=%ld\n", client_fd, n);
3339 }
3340 return app_async_flush_exit(client_fd, conn, CWIST_ASYNC_CLOSE, false);
3341 }
3342 /* Cooperative yield: buffered pipelined bytes cannot wait for a read
3343 * event, but serving the whole turn inline serializes every other
3344 * connection on this reactor. Exit to the continuation path below,
3345 * which reposts this connection so it resumes after the ready CQEs. */
3346 if ((handled + 1) % yield_batch == 0 && conn->len > 0) break;
3347 }
3348 if (conn->len > 0) {
3349 /* Buffered work cannot wait for another read event. The continuation
3350 * owns fd/conn on success; rearm closes both on failure. A parked
3351 * flush owns them instead and re-arms after draining. */
3352 cwist_coalesce_flush_status_t fs = cwist_http_coalesce_flush(client_fd, conn, true);
3353 if (fs == CWIST_COALESCE_FLUSH_ERROR) return CWIST_ASYNC_CLOSE;
3354 if (fs == CWIST_COALESCE_FLUSH_PARKED) {
3355#ifdef CWIST_PFC_TESTING
3356 /* Same park counter as app_async_flush_exit: this continuation
3357 * flush can produce PARKED too (issue #172). The seam has no
3358 * in-tree caller; declare it so an external harness compiling
3359 * this file with -DCWIST_PFC_TESTING does not rely on an
3360 * implicit declaration. */
3361 extern void cwist_pfc_test_parked(void);
3362 cwist_pfc_test_parked();
3363#endif
3364 return CWIST_ASYNC_DEFER;
3365 }
3366 cwist_http_async_rearm(client_fd, conn->reactor, conn);
3367 return CWIST_ASYNC_DEFER;
3368 }
3369 return app_async_flush_exit(
3370 client_fd, conn, conn->peer_eof ? CWIST_ASYNC_CLOSE : CWIST_ASYNC_REARM, !conn->peer_eof);
3371}
3372#endif /* CWIST_WASI_NO_SOCKETS */
3373
3374#ifndef CWIST_WASI_NO_SOCKETS
3375void cwist_app_http_handler(int client_fd, void *ctx) {
3376 cwist_app *app = (cwist_app *)ctx;
3377
3378 if (app->use_http2) {
3379 char peek_buf[24];
3380 ssize_t peeked = recv(client_fd, peek_buf, 24, MSG_PEEK);
3381 if (peeked >= 24 && memcmp(peek_buf, "PRI * HTTP/2.0\r\n\r\nSM\r\n\r\n", 24) == 0) {
3382 cwist_https_connection conn = {.fd = client_fd,
3383 .ssl = NULL,
3384 .negotiated_http2 = true,
3385 .negotiated_protocol = CWIST_HTTPS_PROTOCOL_HTTP2};
3386 cwist_http2_serve_connection_ex(&conn, app, static_http2_route_bridge,
3387 cwist_grpc_http2_hooks());
3388 close(client_fd);
3389 return;
3390 }
3391 }
3392
3393 /* Apply Choi Seok-jeong's Lattice (Sanpan) for priority scaling. */
3394 uint32_t tid = ttak_net_lattice_get_worker_id();
3395 uint16_t node_id = (uint16_t)(client_fd % TTAK_MOLS_NODE_COUNT);
3396 uint32_t mixed_seed = ttak_apply_mols_control(node_id, tid);
3397
3398 /* Jeungseung Gaebang Scaling for priority weighting. */
3399 uint32_t priority_weight = ((mixed_seed * 16777619U) >> 8) % 100;
3400
3401 /* Use stack-allocated buffer for zero-allocation ingress path.
3402 * Aligned to cache line to optimize lattice-friendly access and prevent buffer loss. */
3403 _Alignas(64) char read_buf[CWIST_HTTP_READ_BUFFER_SIZE];
3404 size_t buf_len = 0;
3405 read_buf[0] = '\0';
3406
3407 while (true) {
3408 // --- Zero-Alloc Ingress Fast-Path for Cached / Fixed BDR Endpoints ---
3409 if (app->bdr_ctx) {
3410 while (true) {
3411 if (buf_len == 0) {
3412 ssize_t bytes = recv(client_fd, read_buf, sizeof(read_buf) - 1, 0);
3413 if (bytes <= 0) {
3414 if (bytes < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
3415 close(client_fd);
3416 return;
3417 }
3418 buf_len = (size_t)bytes;
3419 read_buf[buf_len] = '\0';
3420 }
3421
3422 char *hdr_end = (char *)cwist_simd_find_crlfcrlf(read_buf, buf_len);
3423 if (hdr_end && (read_buf[0] == 'G' && read_buf[1] == 'E' && read_buf[2] == 'T' &&
3424 read_buf[3] == ' ')) {
3425 const char *path_start = read_buf + 4;
3426 const char *path_end =
3427 (const char *)memchr(path_start, ' ', (size_t)(hdr_end - path_start));
3428 if (path_end) {
3429 char path_tmp[256];
3430 size_t plen = (size_t)(path_end - path_start);
3431 if (plen < sizeof(path_tmp)) {
3432 memcpy(path_tmp, path_start, plen);
3433 path_tmp[plen] = '\0';
3434 size_t cached_len = 0;
3435 const void *cached_blob =
3436 cwist_bdr_get(app->bdr_ctx, "GET", path_tmp, &cached_len);
3437 if (cached_blob && cached_len > 0) {
3438 ssize_t sret =
3439 send(client_fd, cached_blob, cached_len, MSG_NOSIGNAL);
3440 if (sret <= 0) {
3441 close(client_fd);
3442 return;
3443 }
3444 size_t consumed = (size_t)(hdr_end + 4 - read_buf);
3445 if (buf_len > consumed) {
3446 memmove(read_buf, read_buf + consumed, buf_len - consumed);
3447 buf_len -= consumed;
3448 read_buf[buf_len] = '\0';
3449 } else {
3450 buf_len = 0;
3451 read_buf[0] = '\0';
3452 }
3453 continue;
3454 }
3455 }
3456 }
3457 }
3458 break;
3459 }
3460 }
3461
3462 cwist_http_parse_error_t perr = CWIST_HTTP_PARSE_OK;
3463 cwist_http_request *req =
3464 cwist_http_receive_request(client_fd, read_buf, sizeof(read_buf), &buf_len, &perr);
3465 if (!req) {
3466 app_maybe_send_parse_error(client_fd, perr);
3467 break;
3468 }
3469 req->client_fd = client_fd;
3470 req->app = app;
3471 req->db = app->db;
3472
3473 app_serve_result_t sr = app_serve_parsed_request(app, client_fd, req, priority_weight);
3474 if (sr == APP_SERVE_DEFERRED) {
3475 /* The async completion owns the fd now; it re-arms on the pool
3476 * (keep-alive) or closes. Do not close here. */
3477 return;
3478 }
3479 if (sr == APP_SERVE_CLOSE) {
3480 break;
3481 }
3482 }
3483
3484 close(client_fd);
3485}
3486#endif /* CWIST_WASI_NO_SOCKETS (socket serving machinery) */
3487#endif /* __EMSCRIPTEN__ (socket serving machinery) */
3488
3489#if !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) && !defined(__wasi__)
3490/* Multiport listeners are socket/UDP machinery; WASM hosts never bind. */
3491#ifndef CWIST_MULTIPORT_MAX_PORTS
3492#define CWIST_MULTIPORT_MAX_PORTS 64
3493#endif
3494
3495typedef struct cwist_multiport_slot {
3496 unsigned short port;
3497 cwist_app *app;
3498 bool detached;
3499 struct cwist_multiport_slot *next;
3500} cwist_multiport_slot;
3501
3502typedef struct cwist_multiport_h3_listener {
3503 unsigned short port;
3504 int udp_fd;
3505 pthread_t thread;
3506 bool thread_started;
3507 bool running;
3508 cwist_app *app;
3509 cwist_http3_context *ctx;
3510} cwist_multiport_h3_listener;
3511
3512typedef struct cwist_multiport_group {
3513 cwist_app *root;
3514 unsigned short public_port;
3515 cwist_multiport_slot *slots;
3516 cwist_multiport_h3_listener h3_listeners[CWIST_MULTIPORT_MAX_PORTS];
3517 size_t h3_listener_count;
3518 struct cwist_multiport_group *next;
3519} cwist_multiport_group;
3520
3521static cwist_multiport_group *g_cwist_multiport_groups = NULL;
3522
3529cwist_multiport_t cwist_create_multiport_from_array(const unsigned short *ports, size_t count) {
3530 cwist_multiport_t result;
3531 memset(&result, 0, sizeof(result));
3532 result.valid = false;
3533
3534 if (count > CWIST_MULTIPORT_MAX_PORTS) {
3535 return result;
3536 }
3537 if (!ports && count > 0) {
3538 return result;
3539 }
3540
3541 for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
3542 if (ports[i] == 0) {
3543 break;
3544 }
3545 result.ports[result.count++] = ports[i];
3546 }
3547
3548 result.valid = true;
3549 return result;
3550}
3551
3557static cwist_multiport_group *cwist_multiport_find_group(cwist_app *root) {
3558 cwist_multiport_group *group = g_cwist_multiport_groups;
3559 while (group) {
3560 if (group->root == root) return group;
3561 group = group->next;
3562 }
3563 return NULL;
3564}
3565
3571static cwist_multiport_group *cwist_multiport_get_group(cwist_app *root) {
3572 if (!root) return NULL;
3573 cwist_multiport_group *group = cwist_multiport_find_group(root);
3574 if (group) return group;
3575
3576 group = (cwist_multiport_group *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(*group));
3577 if (!group) return NULL;
3578 memset(group, 0, sizeof(*group));
3579 group->root = root;
3580 group->next = g_cwist_multiport_groups;
3581 g_cwist_multiport_groups = group;
3582 return group;
3583}
3584
3591static cwist_multiport_slot *cwist_multiport_find_slot(cwist_multiport_group *group,
3592 unsigned short port) {
3593 if (!group) return NULL;
3594 cwist_multiport_slot *slot = group->slots;
3595 while (slot) {
3596 if (slot->port == port) return slot;
3597 slot = slot->next;
3598 }
3599 return NULL;
3600}
3601
3606static void cwist_multiport_unlink_app(cwist_app *app) {
3607 if (!app) return;
3608 cwist_multiport_group *group = g_cwist_multiport_groups;
3609 while (group) {
3610 cwist_multiport_slot **link = &group->slots;
3611 while (*link) {
3612 cwist_multiport_slot *slot = *link;
3613 if (slot->app == app) {
3614 *link = slot->next;
3615 cwist_free(slot);
3616 continue;
3617 }
3618 link = &slot->next;
3619 }
3620 group = group->next;
3621 }
3622}
3623
3628static void cwist_multiport_h3_stop_group(cwist_multiport_group *group) {
3629 if (!group) return;
3630 for (size_t i = 0; i < group->h3_listener_count; i++) {
3631 cwist_multiport_h3_listener *listener = &group->h3_listeners[i];
3632 if (listener->ctx) {
3633 listener->ctx->running = 0;
3634 }
3635 if (listener->udp_fd >= 0) {
3636 close(listener->udp_fd);
3637 listener->udp_fd = -1;
3638 }
3639 if (listener->thread_started) {
3640 pthread_join(listener->thread, NULL);
3641 listener->thread_started = false;
3642 listener->running = false;
3643 }
3644 if (listener->ctx) {
3645 cwist_http3_destroy_context(listener->ctx);
3646 listener->ctx = NULL;
3647 }
3648 }
3649 group->h3_listener_count = 0;
3650}
3651
3656static void cwist_multiport_destroy_owned_subapps(cwist_app *root) {
3657 if (!root) return;
3658 cwist_multiport_group **link = &g_cwist_multiport_groups;
3659 while (*link) {
3660 cwist_multiport_group *group = *link;
3661 if (group->root != root) {
3662 link = &group->next;
3663 continue;
3664 }
3665
3666 cwist_multiport_h3_stop_group(group);
3667
3668 cwist_multiport_slot *slot = group->slots;
3669 while (slot) {
3670 cwist_multiport_slot *next = slot->next;
3671 if (slot->detached && slot->app && slot->app != root) {
3672 cwist_app *sub_app = slot->app;
3673 slot->app = NULL;
3674 cwist_app_destroy(sub_app);
3675 }
3676 cwist_free(slot);
3677 slot = next;
3678 }
3679
3680 *link = group->next;
3681 cwist_free(group);
3682 return;
3683 }
3684}
3685
3691/* A cloned route shares the source's user context but never owns it: the
3692 * source app outlives its multiport sub-apps and releases the context once. */
3693static cwist_route_target cwist_route_clone_target(const cwist_route_entry *entry) {
3694 cwist_route_target target = {.handler = entry->handler,
3695 .handler_ex = entry->handler_ex,
3696 .user_ctx = entry->user_ctx,
3697 .ctx_destroy = NULL,
3698 .ws_handler = entry->ws_handler};
3699 return target;
3700}
3701
3702static cwist_route_table *cwist_route_table_clone(cwist_route_table *src) {
3703 if (!src) return cwist_route_table_create();
3704 cwist_route_table *dst = cwist_route_table_create();
3705 if (!dst) return NULL;
3706
3707 for (size_t i = 0; i < src->bucket_count; i++) {
3708 for (cwist_route_entry *entry = src->buckets[i]; entry; entry = entry->next) {
3709 cwist_route_target target = cwist_route_clone_target(entry);
3710 cwist_route_table_insert(dst, entry->path, entry->name, entry->method, &target,
3711 entry->opts);
3712 }
3713 }
3714 for (cwist_route_entry *entry = src->param_routes; entry; entry = entry->next) {
3715 cwist_route_target target = cwist_route_clone_target(entry);
3716 cwist_route_table_insert(dst, entry->path, entry->name, entry->method, &target,
3717 entry->opts);
3718 }
3719 return dst;
3720}
3721
3727static cwist_middleware_node *cwist_middleware_clone(cwist_middleware_node *src) {
3728 cwist_middleware_node *head = NULL;
3729 cwist_middleware_node **tail = &head;
3730 while (src) {
3731 cwist_middleware_node *node = (cwist_middleware_node *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(*node));
3732 if (!node) break;
3733 node->func = src->func;
3734 /* Like a cloned route, a cloned extended middleware shares the source's
3735 * context without owning it: the source app releases it once. */
3736 node->func_ex = src->func_ex;
3737 node->user_ctx = src->user_ctx;
3738 node->destroy = NULL;
3739 node->is_ex = src->is_ex;
3740 node->next = NULL;
3741 *tail = node;
3742 tail = &node->next;
3743 src = src->next;
3744 }
3745 return head;
3746}
3747
3753static cwist_error_handler_entry *cwist_error_handlers_clone(cwist_error_handler_entry *src) {
3754 cwist_error_handler_entry *head = NULL;
3755 cwist_error_handler_entry **tail = &head;
3756 while (src) {
3757 cwist_error_handler_entry *entry = (cwist_error_handler_entry *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(*entry));
3758 if (!entry) break;
3759 entry->status_code = src->status_code;
3760 entry->handler = src->handler;
3761 entry->next = NULL;
3762 *tail = entry;
3763 tail = &entry->next;
3764 src = src->next;
3765 }
3766 return head;
3767}
3768
3774static cwist_static_dir *cwist_static_dirs_clone(cwist_static_dir *src) {
3775 cwist_static_dir *head = NULL;
3776 cwist_static_dir **tail = &head;
3777 while (src) {
3778 cwist_static_dir *entry = (cwist_static_dir *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(*entry));
3779 if (!entry) break;
3780 entry->url_prefix = cwist_strdup(src->url_prefix);
3781 entry->fs_root = cwist_strdup(src->fs_root);
3782 entry->cache_control = src->cache_control ? cwist_strdup(src->cache_control) : NULL;
3783 entry->next = NULL;
3784 if (!entry->url_prefix || !entry->fs_root ||
3785 (src->cache_control && !entry->cache_control)) {
3786 cwist_free(entry->url_prefix);
3787 cwist_free(entry->fs_root);
3788 cwist_free(entry->cache_control);
3789 cwist_free(entry);
3790 break;
3791 }
3792 *tail = entry;
3793 tail = &entry->next;
3794 src = src->next;
3795 }
3796 return head;
3797}
3798
3804static cwist_app *cwist_app_clone_for_multiport(cwist_app *src) {
3805 if (!src) return NULL;
3806 cwist_app *dst = cwist_app_create();
3807 if (!dst) return NULL;
3808
3809 cwist_route_table *router = cwist_route_table_clone(src->router);
3810 if (!router) {
3811 cwist_app_destroy(dst);
3812 return NULL;
3813 }
3814 cwist_route_table_destroy(dst->router);
3815 dst->router = router;
3816
3817 dst->port = src->port;
3818 dst->use_http2 = src->use_http2;
3819 dst->use_https2 = src->use_https2;
3820 dst->use_http3 = src->use_http3;
3821 dst->use_https3 = src->use_https3;
3822 dst->error_handler = src->error_handler;
3823 dst->max_mem_space = src->max_mem_space;
3824 dst->pqc_layer_enabled = src->pqc_layer_enabled;
3825 if (src->tls_groups) {
3826 dst->tls_groups = cwist_strdup(src->tls_groups);
3827 }
3828 dst->wt_handler = src->wt_handler;
3829
3830 dst->middlewares = cwist_middleware_clone(src->middlewares);
3831 dst->error_handlers = cwist_error_handlers_clone(src->error_handlers);
3832 dst->static_dirs = cwist_static_dirs_clone(src->static_dirs);
3833 if (cwist_assets_clone(&dst->assets, src->assets) != 0) {
3834 cwist_app_destroy(dst);
3835 return NULL;
3836 }
3837 if (cwist_grpc_routes_clone(dst, src) != 0) {
3838 cwist_app_destroy(dst);
3839 return NULL;
3840 }
3841
3842 if (src->use_ssl && src->cert_path && src->key_path) {
3843 dst->use_https2 = src->use_https2;
3844 dst->use_https3 = src->use_https3;
3845 cwist_app_use_https(dst, src->cert_path, src->key_path);
3846 }
3847 if (src->use_http3) {
3848 cwist_app_use_http3(dst, true);
3849 }
3850 if (src->h3_ctx && dst->h3_ctx) {
3851 cwist_multiport_h3_copy_tunables(dst->h3_ctx, src->h3_ctx);
3852 }
3853 if (src->db_path && !src->nuke_enabled) {
3854 cwist_app_use_db(dst, src->db_path);
3855 }
3856 cwist_app_refresh_https_request_handler(dst);
3857 return dst;
3858}

3866cwist_app *cwist_multiport_get_app(cwist_app **app_ref, unsigned short port) {
3867 cwist_app *root = app_ref ? *app_ref : NULL;
3868 if (!root || port == 0 || port == (unsigned short)root->port) return NULL;
3869
3870 cwist_multiport_group *group = cwist_multiport_get_group(root);
3871 if (!group) return NULL;
3872
3873 cwist_multiport_slot *slot = cwist_multiport_find_slot(group, port);
3874 if (slot) {
3875 return slot->detached ? slot->app : NULL;
3876 }
3877
3878 cwist_app *sub_app = cwist_app_clone_for_multiport(root);
3879 if (!sub_app) return NULL;
3880 sub_app->port = port;
3881
3882 slot = (cwist_multiport_slot *)cwist_alloc(sizeof(*slot));
3883 if (!slot) {
3884 cwist_app_destroy(sub_app);
3885 return NULL;
3886 }
3887 slot->port = port;
3888 slot->app = sub_app;
3889 slot->detached = true;
3890 slot->next = group->slots;
3891 group->slots = slot;
3892 return sub_app;
3893}

3896 int client_fd;

3900static void *cwist_multiport_http_client_thread(void *arg) {

3902 if (!client) return NULL;

3908static int cwist_multiport_add_port(unsigned short *ports, size_t *count, unsigned short port) {
3909 if (!ports || !count || port == 0) return -1;
3910 for (size_t i = 0; i < *count; i++) {
3911 if (ports[i] == port) return 0;
3912 }
3913 if (*count >= CWIST_MULTIPORT_MAX_PORTS) return -1;
3914 ports[*count] = port;
3915 (*count)++;
3916 return 0;
3917}

3919static int cwist_multiport_set_nonblocking(int fd) {
3920 int flags = fcntl(fd, F_GETFL, 0);
3921 if (flags < 0) return -1;
3922 return fcntl(fd, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);
3923}

3925static void cwist_multiport_close_all(struct pollfd *pfds, size_t count) {
3926 if (!pfds) return;
3927 for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
3928 if (pfds[i].fd >= 0) {
3929 close(pfds[i].fd);
3930 pfds[i].fd = -1;
3931 }
3932 }
3933}

3935static int cwist_multiport_start_clear_client(int client_fd, cwist_app *app) {
3936 cwist_multiport_http_client *payload = malloc(sizeof(*payload));
3937 if (!payload) {
3938 close(client_fd);
3939 return -1;
3940 }
3941
3942 payload->client_fd = client_fd;
3943 payload->app = app;
3944
3945 pthread_t tid;
3946 if (pthread_create(&tid, NULL, cwist_multiport_http_client_thread, payload) != 0) {
3947 close(client_fd);
3948 free(payload);
3949 return -1;
3950 }
3951 pthread_detach(tid);
3952 return 0;
3953}

3989static void cwist_multiport_h3_copy_tunables(cwist_http3_context *dst,
3990 const cwist_http3_context *src) {
3991 if (!dst || !src) return;
3992 dst->push_enabled = src->push_enabled;
3993 dst->early_data_enabled = src->early_data_enabled;
3994 dst->allow_migration = src->allow_migration;
3995 dst->datagram_enabled = src->datagram_enabled;
3996 dst->datagram_cb = src->datagram_cb;
3997 dst->datagram_user_ctx = src->datagram_user_ctx;
3998 dst->wt_handler = src->wt_handler;
3999 dst->idle_timeout_ms = src->idle_timeout_ms;
4000 dst->handshake_timeout_ms = src->handshake_timeout_ms;

4011static cwist_error_t cwist_multiport_h3_context_create(cwist_app *app, cwist_http3_context **out) {
4012 cwist_error_t err = make_error(CWIST_ERR_INT16);
4013 if (!app || !out) {
4014 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
4015 return err;
4016 }
4017 *out = NULL;
4018
4019 if (app->use_https3) {
4020 if (!app->cert_path || !app->key_path) {
4021 err.error.err_i16 = -1;
4022 return err;
4023 }
4024 err = cwist_http3_init_context(out, app->cert_path, app->key_path);
4025 } else if (app->use_http3) {
4026 err = cwist_http3_init_context_ephemeral(out);
4027 } else {
4028 err.error.err_i16 = 0;
4029 return err;
4030 }
4031
4032 if (err.error.err_i16 == 0 && app->h3_ctx && *out) {
4033 cwist_multiport_h3_copy_tunables(*out, app->h3_ctx);
4034 }
4035 return err;
4036}

4043static int cwist_multiport_bind_udp(unsigned short port) {
4044 int udp_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
4045 if (udp_fd < 0) return -1;
4046
4047 struct sockaddr_in udp_addr;
4048 memset(&udp_addr, 0, sizeof(udp_addr));
4049 udp_addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
4050 udp_addr.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr("0.0.0.0");
4051 udp_addr.sin_port = htons(port);
4052
4053 int opt = 1;
4054 setsockopt(udp_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
4055#ifdef SO_REUSEPORT
4056 setsockopt(udp_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEPORT, &opt, sizeof(opt));
4057#endif
4058 int rcvbuf = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
4059 int sndbuf = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
4060 setsockopt(udp_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVBUF, &rcvbuf, sizeof(rcvbuf));
4061 setsockopt(udp_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, &sndbuf, sizeof(sndbuf));
4062
4063 if (bind(udp_fd, (struct sockaddr *)&udp_addr, sizeof(udp_addr)) != 0) {
4064 close(udp_fd);
4065 return -1;
4066 }
4067 return udp_fd;
4068}

4075static void *cwist_multiport_h3_thread(void *arg) {
4076 cwist_multiport_h3_listener *listener = (cwist_multiport_h3_listener *)arg;
4077 if (!listener || !listener->ctx || !listener->app) return NULL;
4078 cwist_http3_server_loop(listener->udp_fd, listener->ctx, static_http3_route_bridge,
4079 listener->app);
4080 listener->running = false;
4081 return NULL;
4082}
4083
4091static int cwist_multiport_h3_start_one(cwist_multiport_group *group, cwist_app *app,
4092 unsigned short port) {
4093 if (!group || !app || (!app->use_http3 && !app->use_https3)) return 0;
4094 if (group->h3_listener_count >= CWIST_MULTIPORT_MAX_PORTS) return -1;
4095
4096 cwist_multiport_h3_listener *listener = &group->h3_listeners[group->h3_listener_count];
4097 memset(listener, 0, sizeof(*listener));
4098 listener->port = port;
4099 listener->udp_fd = -1;
4100 listener->app = app;
4101
4102 cwist_error_t err = cwist_multiport_h3_context_create(app, &listener->ctx);
4103 if (err.error.err_i16 < 0 || !listener->ctx) {
4104 return -1;
4105 }
4106
4107 listener->udp_fd = cwist_multiport_bind_udp(port);
4108 if (listener->udp_fd < 0) {
4109 cwist_http3_destroy_context(listener->ctx);
4110 listener->ctx = NULL;
4111 return -1;
4112 }
4113
4114 if (pthread_create(&listener->thread, NULL, cwist_multiport_h3_thread, listener) != 0) {
4115 close(listener->udp_fd);
4116 listener->udp_fd = -1;
4117 cwist_http3_destroy_context(listener->ctx);
4118 listener->ctx = NULL;
4119 return -1;
4120 }
4121
4122 listener->thread_started = true;
4123 listener->running = true;
4124 group->h3_listener_count++;
4125 if (g_cwist_udp_fd < 0) {
4126 g_cwist_udp_fd = listener->udp_fd;
4127 }
4128 printf("CWIST multiport HTTP/3 fan-out listening on UDP port %hu\n", port);
4129 return 0;
4130}
4131
4140static int cwist_multiport_h3_start_all(cwist_multiport_group *group, cwist_app *root,
4141 const unsigned short *bind_ports, size_t port_count) {
4142 if (!group || !root || !bind_ports) return -1;
4143 cwist_multiport_h3_stop_group(group);
4144 for (size_t i = 0; i < port_count; i++) {
4145 cwist_app *port_app = cwist_multiport_bound_app(group, root, bind_ports[i]);
4146 if (cwist_multiport_h3_start_one(group, port_app, bind_ports[i]) != 0) {
4147 cwist_multiport_h3_stop_group(group);
4148 return -1;
4149 }
4150 }
4151 return 0;
4152}
4153
4160static int cwist_multiport_validate_port_app(cwist_app *app, unsigned short port) {
4161 if (!app) return -1;
4162 if (app->use_ssl && app->use_http2) {
4163 fprintf(stderr, "Port %hu invalid: cleartext HTTP/2 cannot share a TLS listener.\n", port);
4164 return -1;
4165 }
4166 if (!app->use_ssl && app->use_https2) {
4167 fprintf(stderr, "Port %hu invalid: HTTPS/2 requires cwist_app_use_https.\n", port);
4168 return -1;
4169 }
4170 if (app->use_ssl && !app->ssl_ctx) {
4171 fprintf(stderr, "Port %hu invalid: SSL enabled but context not initialized.\n", port);
4172 return -1;
4173 }
4174 if (app->use_http3 && app->use_https3) {
4175 fprintf(stderr,
4176 "Port %hu invalid: ephemeral HTTP/3 and TLS HTTP/3 cannot both be enabled.\n",
4177 port);
4178 return -1;
4179 }
4180 if (app->use_https3 && (!app->cert_path || !app->key_path)) {
4181 fprintf(stderr, "Port %hu invalid: HTTPS/3 requires certificate and key paths.\n", port);
4182 return -1;
4183 }
4184 return 0;
4185}
4186
4195static bool cwist_multiport_needs_https_pool(cwist_multiport_group *group, cwist_app *root,
4196 const unsigned short *bind_ports, size_t port_count) {
4197 for (size_t i = 0; i < port_count; i++) {
4198 cwist_app *port_app = cwist_multiport_bound_app(group, root, bind_ports[i]);
4199 if (port_app && port_app->use_ssl) return true;
4200 }
4201 return false;
4202}
4203
4210int cwist_app_multiport(cwist_app **app_ref, unsigned short public_port, cwist_multiport_t ports) {
4211 signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN);
4212 cwist_shutdown_install_handlers();
4213 cwist_app_tune_system();
4214
4215 cwist_app *app = app_ref ? *app_ref : NULL;
4216 if (!app || public_port == 0 || !ports.valid) return -1;
4217 app->port = public_port;
4218
4219 cwist_multiport_group *group = cwist_multiport_get_group(app);
4220 if (!group) return -1;
4221 group->public_port = public_port;
4222
4223 for (cwist_multiport_slot *slot = group->slots; slot; slot = slot->next) {
4224 if (slot->detached && slot->port == public_port) {
4225 fprintf(stderr, "cwist_multiport_get_app cannot detach the public/default port %hu.\n",
4226 public_port);
4227 return -1;
4228 }
4229 if (slot->detached && !cwist_multiport_contains(ports, slot->port)) {
4230 fprintf(
4231 stderr,
4232 "Detached multiport sub-app port %hu is not present in the multiport descriptor.\n",
4233 slot->port);
4234 return -1;
4235 }
4236 }
4237
4238 if (app->use_ssl && app->use_http2) {
4239 fprintf(stderr,
4240 "Assertion failed: Cannot use cleartext HTTP/2 and HTTPS on the same port.\n");
4241 return -1;
4242 }
4243 if (!app->use_ssl && app->use_https2) {
4244 fprintf(
4245 stderr,
4246 "Assertion failed: Cannot use HTTPS/2 without configuring SSL via cwist_app_use_https.\n");
4247 return -1;
4248 }
4249 if (app->use_ssl && !app->ssl_ctx) {
4250 fprintf(stderr, "SSL enabled but context not initialized.\n");
4251 return -1;
4252 }
4253
4254 if (!app->mem_manager) {
4255 cwist_mem_init(app);
4256 }
4257 if (app->mem_manager && !app->mem_manager->watcher_running) {
4258 app->mem_manager->watcher_running = true;
4259 pthread_create(&app->mem_manager->watcher_thread, NULL, cwist_mem_watcher, app);
4260 }
4261
4262 unsigned short bind_ports[CWIST_MULTIPORT_MAX_PORTS];
4263 size_t port_count = 0;
4264 if (cwist_multiport_add_port(bind_ports, &port_count, public_port) != 0) {
4265 return -1;
4266 }
4267 for (size_t i = 0; i < ports.count; i++) {
4268 if (cwist_multiport_add_port(bind_ports, &port_count, ports.ports[i]) != 0) {
4269 fprintf(stderr, "cwist_app_multiport supports up to %d total ports.\n",
4270 CWIST_MULTIPORT_MAX_PORTS);
4271 return -1;
4272 }
4273 }
4274
4275 for (size_t i = 0; i < port_count; i++) {
4276 cwist_app *port_app = cwist_multiport_bound_app(group, app, bind_ports[i]);
4277 if (cwist_multiport_validate_port_app(port_app, bind_ports[i]) != 0) {
4278 return -1;
4279 }
4280 }
4281 bool needs_https_pool = cwist_multiport_needs_https_pool(group, app, bind_ports, port_count);
4282
4283 struct pollfd pfds[CWIST_MULTIPORT_MAX_PORTS];
4284 for (size_t i = 0; i < port_count; i++) {
4285 pfds[i].fd = -1;
4286 pfds[i].events = POLLIN;
4287 pfds[i].revents = 0;
4288 }
4289
4290 for (size_t i = 0; i < port_count; i++) {
4291 struct sockaddr_in addr;
4292 int fd = cwist_make_socket_ipv4(&addr, "0.0.0.0", bind_ports[i], 32768);
4293 if (fd < 0) {
4294 perror("Failed to bind multiport listener");
4295 cwist_multiport_close_all(pfds, i);
4296 return -1;
4297 }
4298 if (cwist_multiport_set_nonblocking(fd) != 0) {
4299 perror("Failed to set multiport listener non-blocking");
4300 close(fd);
4301 cwist_multiport_close_all(pfds, i);
4302 return -1;
4303 }
4304 pfds[i].fd = fd;
4305 printf("CWIST multiport facade listening on TCP port %hu\n", bind_ports[i]);
4306 }
4307
4308 if (cwist_multiport_h3_start_all(group, app, bind_ports, port_count) != 0) {
4309 fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize multiport HTTP/3 fan-out.\n");
4310 cwist_multiport_close_all(pfds, port_count);
4311 return -1;
4312 }
4313
4314 if (needs_https_pool && https_pool_init() != 0) {
4315 fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize HTTPS worker pool.\n");
4316 cwist_multiport_h3_stop_group(group);
4317 cwist_multiport_close_all(pfds, port_count);
4318 return -1;
4319 }
4320
4321 g_cwist_listen_fd = pfds[0].fd;
4322 printf("CWIST App running on %zu TCP ports via multiport facade (SSL: %s)\n", port_count,
4323 app->use_ssl ? "On" : "Off");
4324
4325 while (atomic_load(&g_cwist_running)) {
4326 int ready = poll(pfds, (nfds_t)port_count, 1000);
4327 if (ready < 0) {
4328 if (errno == EINTR) continue;
4329 perror("cwist_app_multiport poll");
4330 break;
4331 }
4332 if (ready == 0) continue;
4333
4334 for (size_t i = 0; i < port_count; i++) {
4335 if (!(pfds[i].revents & POLLIN)) continue;
4336
4337 while (atomic_load(&g_cwist_running)) {
4338 struct sockaddr_in peer;
4339 socklen_t peer_len = sizeof(peer);
4340 int client_fd = accept(pfds[i].fd, (struct sockaddr *)&peer, &peer_len);
4341 if (client_fd < 0) {
4342 int accept_err = errno;
4343 if (accept_err == EAGAIN || accept_err == EWOULDBLOCK || accept_err == EINTR)
4344 break;
4345 if (accept_err == EBADF || accept_err == EINVAL || accept_err == ENOTSOCK) {
4346 atomic_store(&g_cwist_running, 0);
4347 break;
4348 }
4349 continue;
4350 }
4351
4352 int nodelay = 1;
4353 setsockopt(client_fd, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY, &nodelay, sizeof(nodelay));
4354
4355 cwist_app *port_app = cwist_multiport_bound_app(group, app, bind_ports[i]);
4356 if (port_app->use_ssl) {
4357 https_pool_submit(client_fd, port_app->ssl_ctx, static_ssl_handler, port_app);
4358 } else {
4359 cwist_multiport_start_clear_client(client_fd, port_app);
4360 }
4361 }
4362 }
4363 }
4364
4365 if (needs_https_pool) {
4366 https_pool_destroy();
4367 }
4368 cwist_multiport_h3_stop_group(group);
4369 cwist_multiport_close_all(pfds, port_count);
4370 g_cwist_listen_fd = -1;
4371 g_cwist_udp_fd = -1;
4372
4373 if (app->mem_manager) {
4374 app->mem_manager->watcher_running = false;
4375 }
4376
4377 printf("[CWIST] Multiport facade shutdown complete.\n");
4378 return 0;
4379}
4380#endif /* __EMSCRIPTEN__ (multiport) */

4416void cwist_apply_profile(void) {
4417 const char *profile = getenv("CWIST_PROFILE");
4418 if (!profile || profile[0] == '\0' || strcmp(profile, "default") == 0) {
4419 setenv("CWIST_C1M_MODE", "1", 0);
4420 setenv("CWIST_REACTOR_DRAIN_CHUNK", "8", 0);
4421 return;
4422 }
4423
4424 if (strcmp(profile, "performance") == 0) {
4425 setenv("CWIST_C1M_MODE", "1", 0);
4426 setenv("CWIST_MALLOC_ARENA_MAX", "1", 0);
4427 setenv("CWIST_REACTOR_DRAIN_CHUNK", "8", 0);
4428 setenv("CWIST_HTTP_BATCH", "64", 0);
4429 printf("[CWIST] profile: performance\n");
4430 } else if (strcmp(profile, "lowmem") == 0) {
4431 setenv("CWIST_C1M_MODE", "1", 0);
4432 setenv("CWIST_MALLOC_ARENA_MAX", "1", 0);
4433 setenv("CWIST_WORKERS", "2", 0);
4434 printf("[CWIST] profile: lowmem\n");
4435 } else if (strcmp(profile, "lowlat") == 0) {
4436 setenv("CWIST_C1M_MODE", "0", 0);
4437 printf("[CWIST] profile: lowlat\n");
4438 } else {
4439 fprintf(stderr, "[CWIST] unknown CWIST_PROFILE value \"%s\"; using defaults\n", profile);
4440 setenv("CWIST_C1M_MODE", "1", 0);
4441 setenv("CWIST_REACTOR_DRAIN_CHUNK", "8", 0);
4442 }
4443}

4454
4455#if !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) && !defined(CWIST_WASI_NO_SOCKETS)
4456static int app_listen_serve(cwist_app *app, int port, int workers_override, int c1m_override);

4458
4459int cwist_app_listen_ex(cwist_app *app, int port, int workers_override, int c1m_override) {
4460#if defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) || defined(CWIST_WASI_NO_SOCKETS)
4461 (void)port;
4462 (void)workers_override;
4463 (void)c1m_override;
4464 if (app) app->port = port;
4465 return -1; /* WASM hosts drive requests through cwist_app_dispatch_memory() */
4466#else
4467#ifndef __wasi__
4468 // Ignore SIGPIPE
4469 signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN);
4470#endif
4471 /* SIGTERM/SIGINT request a graceful stop only while this server runs:
4472 * the caller's own handlers are back in place when it returns, on every
4473 * path (including in forked workers, which also return here). */
4474 cwist_shutdown_install_handlers();
4475 int rc = app_listen_serve(app, port, workers_override, c1m_override);
4476 cwist_shutdown_restore_handlers();
4477 return rc;
4478#endif
4479}
4480
4481#if !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__) && !defined(CWIST_WASI_NO_SOCKETS)
4482/* Body of cwist_app_listen_ex() between installing and restoring the
4483 * shutdown signal handlers. */
4484static int app_listen_serve(cwist_app *app, int port, int workers_override, int c1m_override) {
4485 cwist_app_tune_system();
4486 cwist_apply_profile();
4487 if (!app) return -1;
4488 app->port = port;
4489
4490 // Validate protocol combinations for the same port
4491 if (app->use_ssl) {
4492 if (app->use_http2) {
4493 fprintf(stderr,
4494 "Assertion failed: Cannot use cleartext HTTP/2 and HTTPS on the same port.\n");
4495 abort();
4496 }
4497 } else {
4498 if (app->use_https2) {
4499 fprintf(
4500 stderr,
4501 "Assertion failed: Cannot use HTTPS/2 without configuring SSL via cwist_app_use_https.\n");
4502 abort();
4503 }
4504 }
4505
4506 if (app->use_http3 && app->use_https3) {
4507 fprintf(
4508 stderr,
4509 "Assertion failed: Cannot use both ephemeral HTTP/3 and TLS HTTP/3 simultaneously on the same port.\n");
4510 abort();
4511 }
4512
4513 /* Create the shared TCP listen socket before forking workers.
4514 * With SO_REUSEPORT each worker process gets its own accept queue and the
4515 * kernel load-balances incoming connections. Creating it here avoids the
4516 * previous anti-pattern where workers forked before binding and inherited
4517 * threads that do not exist in the child. */
4518 struct sockaddr_in addr;
4519 int server_fd = cwist_make_socket_ipv4(&addr, "0.0.0.0", port, 32768);
4520 if (server_fd < 0) {
4521 perror("Failed to bind port");
4522 return -1;
4523 }
4524 g_cwist_listen_fd = server_fd;
4525
4526 /* Bind the HTTP/3 UDP socket before forking as well. The thread that
4527 * services it is started per-process after the fork. */
4528 int udp_fd = -1;
4529#ifndef __wasi__
4530 if (app->h3_ctx && (app->use_http3 || app->use_https3)) {
4531 udp_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
4532 if (udp_fd >= 0) {
4533 struct sockaddr_in udp_addr;
4534 memset(&udp_addr, 0, sizeof(udp_addr));
4535 udp_addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
4536 udp_addr.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr("0.0.0.0");
4537 udp_addr.sin_port = htons(port);
4538
4539 int opt = 1;
4540 setsockopt(udp_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
4541#ifdef SO_REUSEPORT
4542 setsockopt(udp_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEPORT, &opt, sizeof(opt));
4543#endif
4544 int rcvbuf = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
4545 int sndbuf = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
4546 setsockopt(udp_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVBUF, &rcvbuf, sizeof(rcvbuf));
4547 setsockopt(udp_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, &sndbuf, sizeof(sndbuf));
4548
4549 if (bind(udp_fd, (struct sockaddr *)&udp_addr, sizeof(udp_addr)) != 0) {
4550 perror("Failed to bind UDP port for HTTP/3");
4551 close(udp_fd);
4552 udp_fd = -1;
4553 }
4554 }
4555 }
4556#endif /* __wasi__ (no UDP/threads) */
4557
4558 // Fork worker processes before any threads are created.
4559 int workers = 1;
4560 const char *workers_env = getenv("CWIST_WORKERS");
4561 if (workers_override > 0) {
4562 workers = workers_override;
4563 } else if (workers_env) {
4564 if (strcmp(workers_env, "auto") == 0) {
4565 long cores = get_cpu_cores();
4566 workers = (cores > 0) ? (int)cores : 1;
4567 } else {
4568 char *end = NULL;
4569 long v = strtol(workers_env, &end, 10);
4570 workers = (end != workers_env && *end == '\0' && v >= 1 && v <= INT_MAX) ? (int)v : 1;
4571 }
4572 } else {
4573 // Default to auto (number of online CPU cores) to maximize performance on multi-core
4574 // systems out of the box.
4575 long cores = get_cpu_cores();
4576 workers = (cores > 0) ? (int)cores : 1;
4577 }
4578 if (workers < 1) workers = 1;
4579
4580#if defined(__GLIBC__)
4581 /* Experimental (issue #25, ROADMAP.md v3.5): cap glibc's per-process
4582 * arena count before forking, so the setting is inherited by every
4583 * worker. mallopt() state is plain process memory, not something a
4584 * live fork() can "share back" afterward - COW means a child's first
4585 * write to any inherited page (which malloc always does) forks its own
4586 * private copy immediately, so there's no way to keep multiple
4587 * processes pointed at one mutable arena. What *is* achievable is
4588 * capping how many arenas each process can independently accumulate:
4589 * by default glibc lets internal thread contention grow up to
4590 * ncpus*8 arenas *per process* (each worker here forks before
4591 * creating its own watcher/HTTP-3 threads, so every worker can hit
4592 * that ceiling independently) - with N worker processes that's a
4593 * multiplicative blow-up, and each extra arena is its own mmap'd
4594 * region that adds directly to RSS. CWIST_MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=1 forces
4595 * every worker down to its single main arena regardless of how many
4596 * threads it spins up afterward. Unset by default: preserves today's
4597 * behavior exactly. Measured against the mimalloc A/B in that issue
4598 * and adopted (PR #35, merged) after winning on every metric - the CI
4599 * benchmark job keeps confirming that decision on every run, this is
4600 * not an open question anymore, just still opt-in rather than a
4601 * default so existing deployments' behavior never changes silently. */
4602 const char *arena_max_env = getenv("CWIST_MALLOC_ARENA_MAX");
4603 if (arena_max_env && arena_max_env[0]) {
4604 char *end = NULL;
4605 long arena_max = strtol(arena_max_env, &end, 10);
4606 if (end && *end == '\0' && arena_max >= 0 && arena_max <= INT_MAX) {
4607 mallopt(M_ARENA_MAX, (int)arena_max);
4608 }
4609 }
4610#endif
4611
4612 /* Prime libttak's TSC calibration before forking workers. calibrate_tsc()
4613 * sleeps for 10 ms (timing.c) and is triggered lazily by the first
4614 * ttak_get_tick_count_ns() call - which used to arrive with the first
4615 * request's arena creation inside each worker process, adding ~10 ms to
4616 * that worker's first request. The calibrated g_tsc_freq_ghz/g_tsc_scale
4617 * globals are plain process memory, so fork children inherit the values
4618 * copy-on-write and never repeat the sleep. */
4619#ifndef __wasi__
4620 (void)ttak_get_tick_count_ns();
4621#endif
4622
4623 bool is_worker_child = false;
4624 pid_t worker_pids[workers > 1 ? workers - 1 : 1];
4625 size_t worker_count = 0;
4626 int child_idx = 0;
4627#ifndef __wasi__
4628 for (int i = 1; i < workers; i++) {
4629 pid_t pid = fork();
4630 if (pid == 0) {
4631 is_worker_child = true;
4632 child_idx = i;
4633 break;
4634 } else if (pid < 0) {
4635 perror("fork worker failed");
4636 break;
4637 } else {
4638 worker_pids[worker_count++] = pid;
4639 }
4640 }
4641
4642#if defined(__linux__) && defined(_GNU_SOURCE)
4643 /* Keep each worker inside its inherited affinity mask (including sparse IDs). */
4644 if (workers > 1 && cwist_app_pin_worker((size_t)(is_worker_child ? child_idx : 0)) < 0) {
4645 /* On failure, retain the inherited mask rather than guessing a CPU ID. */
4646 perror("worker CPU affinity");
4647 }
4648#endif
4649
4650 if (is_worker_child) {
4651 close(server_fd);
4652 server_fd = cwist_make_socket_ipv4(&addr, "0.0.0.0", port, 32768);
4653 if (server_fd >= 0) {
4654 g_cwist_listen_fd = server_fd;
4655 }
4656 if (udp_fd >= 0) {
4657 close(udp_fd);
4658 udp_fd = -1;
4659 }
4660 }
4661#else
4662 (void)addr;
4663#endif /* __wasi__ (single process) */
4664
4665 /* The static cache owns a libttak cleanup thread as well as the watcher.
4666 * Initialize it only after all worker forks so no child inherits mutexes
4667 * or a pthread handle whose owning thread exists only in the parent. */
4668#ifndef __wasi__
4669 cwist_mem_init(app);
4670
4671 // Per-process threads start here. Each worker gets its own watcher and
4672 // HTTP/3 thread, so fork-after-thread deadlock is avoided.
4673 if (app->mem_manager) {
4674 app->mem_manager->watcher_running = true;
4675 pthread_create(&app->mem_manager->watcher_thread, NULL, cwist_mem_watcher, app);
4676 }
4677
4678 if (udp_fd >= 0) {
4679 struct h3_thread_payload *h3_p = malloc(sizeof(*h3_p));
4680 if (h3_p) {
4681 h3_p->udp_fd = udp_fd;
4682 h3_p->app = app;
4683 pthread_t h3_tid;
4684 if (pthread_create(&h3_tid, NULL, h3_server_thread_func, h3_p) == 0) {
4685 pthread_detach(h3_tid);
4686 g_cwist_udp_fd = udp_fd;
4687 printf("HTTP/3 (QUIC) enabled on UDP port %d\n", port);
4688 } else {
4689 free(h3_p);
4690 close(udp_fd);
4691 udp_fd = -1;
4692 }
4693 } else {
4694 close(udp_fd);
4695 udp_fd = -1;
4696 }
4697 }
4698
4699#endif /* __wasi__ (no static-cache thread, watcher, or H3 thread) */
4700 printf("CWIST App running on port %d (SSL: %s) [Event-driven, workers=%d, pid=%d]\n", port,
4701 app->use_ssl ? "On" : "Off", workers, (int)getpid());
4702
4703 // Check config for non-blocking scale mode (default enabled)
4704 const char *c1m = getenv("CWIST_C1M_MODE");
4705#ifdef __wasi__
4706 /* The C1M reactor is epoll/eventfd-based; WASI hosts run the blocking
4707 * accept loop instead. */
4708 bool use_c1m = false;
4709#else
4710 bool use_c1m = true;
4711#endif
4712 if (c1m_override < 0 && c1m) {
4713 if (c1m[0] == '0' || strcmp(c1m, "false") == 0) {
4714 use_c1m = false;
4715 }
4716 }
4717#ifndef __wasi__
4718 if (c1m_override >= 0) use_c1m = c1m_override != 0;
4719#else
4720 (void)c1m_override;
4721#endif
4722 if (use_c1m) {
4723 cwist_async_server_loop(server_fd, app);
4724 } else {
4725#ifdef __wasi__
4726 if (app->use_ssl) {
4727 fprintf(stderr, "TLS is not available on WASI (no BoringSSL); serve cleartext.\n");
4728 g_cwist_listen_fd = -1;
4729 return -1;
4730 }
4731 /* Single-threaded host: no pool, no epoll - the blocking accept
4732 * fallback in cwist_http_server_loop() handles one connection at a
4733 * time, which is what a WASM socket grant can drive anyway. */
4734 cwist_server_config config = {
4735 .use_forking = false, .use_threading = false, .use_epoll = false};
4736 cwist_http_server_loop(server_fd, &config, cwist_app_http_handler, app);
4737#else
4738 if (app->use_ssl) {
4739 if (!app->ssl_ctx) {
4740 fprintf(stderr, "SSL enabled but context not initialized.\n");
4741 g_cwist_listen_fd = -1;
4742 return -1;
4743 }
4744 cwist_https_server_loop(server_fd, app->ssl_ctx, static_ssl_handler, app);
4745 } else {
4746 cwist_server_config config = {
4747 .use_forking = false, .use_threading = true, .use_epoll = false};
4748 cwist_http_server_loop(server_fd, &config, cwist_app_http_handler, app);
4749 }
4750#endif
4751 }
4752
4753 /* Graceful shutdown cleanup */
4754 g_cwist_listen_fd = -1;
4755 g_cwist_udp_fd = -1;
4756
4757 if (app->h3_ctx) {
4758 app->h3_ctx->running = 0;
4759 }
4760
4761 if (app->mem_manager) {
4762 app->mem_manager->watcher_running = false;
4763 }
4764
4765 /* Post-stop drain: give in-flight C1M connections a bounded window to
4766 * finish before the process exits, but only for as long as something is
4767 * actually alive. The reactor and pool are already torn down at this
4768 * point, so an idle server used to sleep out the full timeout on every
4769 * shutdown; exit as soon as no connection remains. */
4770 printf("[CWIST] Draining connections for %d seconds...\n", g_cwist_drain_timeout_sec);
4771 if ((is_worker_child || workers == 1) && g_cwist_drain_timeout_sec > 0) {
4772 for (int i = 0; i < g_cwist_drain_timeout_sec * 10; i++) {
4773 if (cwist_http_inflight_count() <= 0) break;
4774 usleep(100 * 1000);
4775 }
4776 }
4777
4778 int worker_result = 0;
4779 /* Parent process reaps worker children so they do not become zombies. */
4780#ifndef __wasi__
4781 if (!is_worker_child && workers > 1) {
4782 /* SIGTERM is delivered to the supervisor only. Ask every worker to
4783 * leave its inherited accept loop before waiting for it; otherwise a
4784 * supervisor shutdown can block indefinitely. */
4785 for (size_t i = 0; i < worker_count; i++) {
4786 kill(worker_pids[i], SIGTERM);
4787 }
4788 for (size_t i = 0; i < worker_count; i++) {
4789 int status;
4790 pid_t reaped;
4791 do {
4792 reaped = waitpid(worker_pids[i], &status, 0);
4793 } while (reaped < 0 && errno == EINTR);
4794 if (reaped < 0) {
4795 perror("waitpid worker");
4796 worker_result = -1;
4797 } else if (!WIFEXITED(status) || WEXITSTATUS(status) != 0) {
4798 fprintf(stderr, "Worker %d exited abnormally (status=%d)\n", (int)worker_pids[i],
4799 status);
4800 worker_result = -1;
4801 }
4802 }
4803 }
4804#else
4805 (void)worker_pids;
4806 (void)worker_count;
4807#endif /* __wasi__ (no child processes) */
4808
4809 printf("[CWIST] Shutdown complete.\n");
4810
4811 return worker_result;
4812}
4813#endif

4817static void cwist_swagger_html_handler(cwist_http_request *req, cwist_http_response *res) {
4818 (void)req;
4819 static const char html[] =
4820 "<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html>\n<head>\n"
4821 "<title>CWIST Swagger UI</title>\n"
4822 "<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"https://unpkg.com/swagger-ui-dist@5/swagger-ui.css\" />\n"
4823 "</head>\n<body>\n"
4824 "<div id=\"swagger-ui\"></div>\n"
4825 "<script src=\"https://unpkg.com/swagger-ui-dist@5/swagger-ui-bundle.js\"></script>\n"
4826 "<script>\n"
4827 "window.onload = () => {\n"
4828 " SwaggerUIBundle({\n"
4829 " url: '/openapi.json',\n"
4830 " dom_id: '#swagger-ui',\n"
4831 " });\n"
4832 "};\n"
4833 "</script>\n"
4834 "</body>\n</html>\n";
4835 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, (char *)html);
4836 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8");
4837}
4838
4839static void cwist_swagger_json_handler(cwist_http_request *req, cwist_http_response *res) {
4840 (void)req;
4841 FILE *f = fopen(cwist_swagger_json_path, "rb");
4842 if (!f) {
4843 res->status_code = 404;
4844 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, (char *)"{\"error\":\"openapi.json not found\"}");
4845 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Content-Type", "application/json");
4846 return;
4847 }
4848 fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
4849 long sz = ftell(f);
4850 fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
4851 char *buf = (char *)malloc((size_t)sz + 1);
4852 if (buf) {
4853 size_t rd = fread(buf, 1, (size_t)sz, f);
4854 buf[rd] = '\0';
4855 cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, buf);
4856 free(buf);
4857 }
4858 fclose(f);
4859 cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Content-Type", "application/json");
4860}

4862void cwist_app_enable_swagger(cwist_app *app, const char *mount_path,
4863 const char *openapi_json_path) {
4864 if (!app) return;
4865 if (openapi_json_path) {
4866 snprintf(cwist_swagger_json_path, sizeof(cwist_swagger_json_path), "%s", openapi_json_path);
4867 }
4868 const char *mp = mount_path ? mount_path : "/docs";
4869 cwist_app_get(app, mp, cwist_swagger_html_handler);
4870 cwist_app_get(app, "/openapi.json", cwist_swagger_json_handler);
4871}
